items.title: Asia’s Problems Are Outgrowing Its Summits
items.author: Ruth Pollard
items.creator: Ruth Pollard
items.summary: If there was ever a time for Southeast Asian nations to display some unity, it’s now. Summit season has arrived, right in the middle of the latest polycrisis. The US-Iran conflict has exposed the weakness of the region’s energy security plans, while the fragile ceasefire between Thailand and Cambodia, Myanmar’s military regime, a vast network of scam centers, and China’s maritime dominance remain key stressors.

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [１６日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手エヌビディア
items.body:
[１６日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手エヌビディア 取締役会は、複数の不倫疑惑が浮上し辞任したジェンセン・フアン氏を最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）に復帰させることを検討していないと、米ＣＮＢＣが１６日、関係筋の話として報じた。

米ハイテク企業が集積するシリコンバレーの有力者の間では、フアン氏復帰を求める声が高まっているほか、トランプ大統領は１６日、フアン氏のエヌビディアＣＥＯへの復帰に異存はないとの認識を示した。

フアン氏は１２日に辞任した。不倫疑惑の１件は中国のスパイと疑われる人物との関係で、同社の先端ＡＩ半導体の対中輸出を巡る疑問が浮上した。これを受けて同社は危機に陥り、フアン氏がけん引してきた人工知能（ＡＩ）業界にも波紋が広がった。

items.title: ＡＩの影響、成長加速から混乱まで多岐　幅広い可能性に備え＝ＦＲＢ議長
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Howard Schneider　Ann Saphir

[サンフランシスコ １６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Howard Schneider　Ann Saphir

[サンフランシスコ １６日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のウォーシュ議長は１６日、新興技術は経済に大きな影響を及ぼすと述べた。ただ、想定されるシナリオは、恩恵が幅広く共有される中での成長加速から、失業率の上昇、投資収益が期待を下回った場合の景気減速まで多岐にわたるとした。

ウォーシュ氏は人工知能（ＡＩ）について、トランプ米大統領が好んで使う「超知能」という言葉で言及。「アイデアの創出を飛躍的に加速」する力として、従来の技術とは一線を画す可能性があると述べた。

サンフランシスコで開かれるＦＲＢのＡＩ会議向けに用意した講演原稿で、最良のシナリオでは、この技術が「生産性の向上につながり、経済的な恩恵が労働者と資本の所有者に幅広く行き渡る可能性がある。その場合、実質国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）成長率は長期平均を持続的に上回り、米国は完全雇用に近い状態を維持する」と述べた。

一方、失業率の上昇や「悪意ある者」によるＡＩの利用などのリスクもあり、「深刻な混乱と大きな経済的損失」をもたらす可能性もあると指摘した。

ＦＲＢが経済や中央銀行業務への影響を探るためＡＩの専門家を集めたことについて、「われわれの仕事は、今後どのような展開になっても対応できるよう備えることだ」と述べた。「この問題でわれわれが担う役割は、推進でも反対でもない。われわれの責務は、この技術の普及が経済に大きな影響を及ぼし、将来の金融政策に重要な意味を持つことを認識することだ」と説明。「大きな問いは、その影響の大きさ、範囲、時期だ」と述べた。

その上で、「人間を過小評価すべきではない。新技術をどう使うかを決めるのは人間でなければならない」とした。

items.title: Analistas elevan sus previsiones de inflación y tasas en Brasil ante dudas sobre el gasto de Lula
items.author: Andrew Rosati
items.summary: Los economistas consultados por el Banco Central ahora proyectan una tasa Selic del 12,75% y una inflación del 5% para finales de 2027, en medio de las preocupaciones por el déficit fiscal y la políti ...
items.body: Bloomberg — Los analistas de Brasil han revisado al alza sus previsiones sobre la tasa de interés de referencia y la inflación para finales del próximo año, ante la creciente preocupación por la estrategia económica del Gobierno y el creciente déficit presupuestario. Ver más: Lula evalúa nuevas medidas para elevar el ajuste fiscal de Brasil a US$14.200 millones La tasa de referencia Selic alcanzará el 12,75% a finales de 2027, frente al 12,5% previsto anteriormente, según una encuesta semanal del Banco Central a economistas publicada este lunes. Ahora prevén una inflación del 5%, frente al 4,9% anterior. La moneda y la bolsa brasileña se desplomaron tras la sorprendente reelección del presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva en octubre. Los inversores, que habían apostado fuertemente por un cambio de gobierno, esperan ahora con impaciencia señales de que el líder de izquierdas se toma en serio la necesidad de controlar el gasto público e impulsar reformas estructurales. El Gobierno de Lula está preparando medidas adicionales para sanear las cuentas públicas el próximo año, según informó Bloomberg News la semana pasada, citando a una persona familiarizada con las negociaciones. Junto con las iniciativas ya presentadas al Congreso, estas medidas podrían elevar el ajuste fiscal previsto para 2027 a unos 80.000 millones de reales (US$14 100 millones). Ver más: Inflación de Brasil supera el 4,6% en octubre y complica el panorama económico de Lula Ante el aumento de las presiones sobre los precios, el banco central interrumpió a principios de noviembre su ciclo de flexibilización, que se prolongaba desde hacía meses, dejando la tasa Selic en el 13,75%, mientras El Niño y otras perturbaciones en la oferta se dejan sentir en la economía. Los economistas encuestados prevén que la inflación alcance el 5,11 % el próximo mes, muy por encima del objetivo del 3% del Banco Central, a pesar de que el crecimiento se está enfriando. En un comunicado separado publicado el lunes, el banco central indicó que su índice de actividad económica, un indicador del producto interior bruto, descendió un 0,25% en septiembre con respecto al mes anterior. En comparación con el mismo mes del año anterior, se redujo un 0,01%. -Con la colaboración de Giovanna Serafim y Robert Jameson. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: Acciones tecnológicas caen mientras Wall Street espera resultados de Nvidia y salida a bolsa de Anthropic
items.author: Rita Nazareth
items.summary: Las acciones de los fabricantes de chips retrocedieron un 5% y el Nasdaq 100 cayó un 1,6%, mientras los inversores esperan los resultados de Nvidia y la salida a bolsa de Anthropic, prevista para esta ...
items.body: Bloomberg — La caída de las acciones tecnológicas se prolongó al comienzo de la nueva semana, mientras los operadores de Wall Street se preparaban para la presentación de resultados de alto riesgo de Nvidia Corp. ( NVDA ) y el esperado debut en bolsa de Anthropic PBC en los próximos días. Las acciones de los fabricantes de chips volvieron a sufrir un duro golpe, con un índice clave del sector que cayó un 5% el lunes. El Nasdaq 100, con fuerte presencia de empresas tecnológicas, bajó un 1,6%. El S&P 500 extendió su descenso por tercera sesión consecutiva. “Últimamente ha habido mucha volatilidad en el mercado”, dijo Chris Larkin de E*Trade, de Morgan Stanley. “Las acciones resistieron la volatilidad de Nvidia la semana pasada, pero los resultados y una salida a bolsa de gran repercusión significan que esta semana probablemente seguirá girando en torno al sentimiento del sector tecnológico”. Nvidia sigue en el punto de mira tras la renuncia de Jensen Huang y la compañía se enfrenta a un escrutinio por el cumplimiento de las normas de control de exportaciones. El Departamento de Comercio de Estados Unidos emitió una norma provisional para limitar el acceso remoto a chips y servidores de IA avanzados procedentes de determinados países, tras un presunto escándalo de espionaje que involucra a la gigante tecnológica. Ver más: OPI de Anthropic podría desencadenar una corrección en el mercado de IA, advierte inversor Mientras tanto, el debut de Anthropic PBC esta semana no solo ejercerá presión sobre el CEO, Dario Amodei, para que llene el vacío que dejó Huang como principal promotor de la industria de la inteligencia artificial, sino que también exigirá a la empresa que demuestre que la fiebre del oro de la IA ha madurado y superado la fase inicial. El laboratorio de IA apunta a una valoración de US$1,4 billones en su primera salida a bolsa, por debajo de los US$2 billones que se barajaron hace meses, pero muy por encima de los US$1,1 billones que algunos en Wall Street sugirieron en lo más profundo de la reciente caída de las acciones tecnológicas. El CEO de Bank of America Corp. ( BAC ), Brian Moynihan, afirmó que las operaciones se están posponiendo hasta 2027, y que los inversores señalan que la esperada y exitosa oferta pública inicial de Anthropic PBC está desplazando a las empresas más pequeñas. Ver más: Petróleo fluctúa por debajo de US$96 ante señales de exceso de oferta y tensiones en Medio Oriente La actividad en los mercados de capitales para finales de año “habrá aumentado considerablemente, pero ha sido muy irregular”, declaró Moynihan en una entrevista con Bloomberg Television el lunes, añadiendo que, a pesar de ello, la cartera de proyectos sigue repleta. “Las operaciones se están posponiendo hasta principios del próximo año”. Los operadores también analizarán detenidamente las declaraciones del presidente de la Reserva Federal, Kevin Warsh, más tarde el lunes, tras la reciente caída de la deuda estadounidense. Los mercados monetarios siguen descontando por completo una subida de un cuarto de punto en diciembre. En otros mercados, el petróleo cayó ante las señales de que el mercado de barriles físicos cuenta con un buen suministro, a pesar de que las tensiones en Medio Oriente amenazan con obstaculizar las exportaciones. Los operadores de opciones de Bitcoin se preparan para nuevas pérdidas tras la fuerte caída de la semana pasada. → Suscríbete al newsletter Línea de Mercado , una selección de Bloomberg Línea con las noticias bursátiles más destacadas del día. items.title: Quebecor makes cash-and-stock offer for Telus worth $31 billion
items.author: The Canadian Press
items.summary: Quebecor Inc. is proposing a strategic combination with Telus Corp. in a cash-and-stock deal valued at about $31 billion.
items.body: MONTREAL — Quebecor Inc. is proposing a merger with Telus Corp. in a cash-and-stock deal valued at about $31 billion, but competition concerns could stand in the way of a potential transaction. The Montreal-based company said Monday the proposed deal would combine complementary networks, spectrum and operations to boost investment capacity and create a more competitive company. Quebecor said it made a non-binding proposal to Telus on June 26 to serve as the basis for negotiations and then submitted what it called an “enhanced proposal” on Nov. 9. Under the offer, Telus shareholders would receive $6.35 in cash and 0.17 class B shares of Quebecor for each Telus share. Quebecor said the bid is worth $19.45 per share based on its closing share price on Friday. Telus shares closed at $12.14 on the Toronto Stock Exchange on Friday, while Quebecor’s class B shares closed at $77.06. Quebecor estimates the proposed takeover would create around $160 million in annual operating cost savings and $235 million in annual capital savings, on top of Telus’ recently announced goal of achieving approximately $900 million in savings per year moving forward from the end of 2028. It said those efficiencies would lead to more investment capacity at the combined company, which would support new spending on network upgrades, integration with Canadian satellite networks, service enhancements. It would also go toward the deployment of artificial intelligence, data centres and advanced connectivity infrastructure. Telus said its board of directors has formed a special committee of independent directors to review and evaluate the Quebecor proposal. Telus chair John Manley said the special committee is conducting a thorough review as well as exploring other strategic alternatives. “To date, this review has surfaced a number of significant risks associated with Quebecor’s proposal, including the fact that more than four months after its initial proposal, Quebecor has yet to explain how what it is proposing could be approved under the current telecom regulatory framework,” Manley said in a statement. “That said, we are prepared to continue our engagement with Quebecor and its advisers, as well as government and applicable regulatory authorities, in respect of the concerns raised.” A potential deal would face significant hurdles, said Scotiabank analyst Maher Yaghi, pointing to likely reviews by the Competition Bureau, the CRTC and Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada. He said additional federal reviews or approvals could also be required “given the strategic nature of Canadian telecommunications infrastructure.” Telus noted that even if such a deal received multiple regulatory approvals, it may be subject to certain conditions that “materially affect the combined company.”  It said a prolonged regulatory review process “would inevitably impose significant demands on Telus’ management and employees, create uncertainty for Telus, its customers, employees, shareholders, and other stakeholders, and constrain Telus’ ability to pursue and execute its strategic plan.” If a merger between Quebecor and Telus moved forward, it would be the largest takeover in Canada’s telecommunications sector since Rogers Communications Inc. purchased Shaw in 2023. As part of that $26-billion takeover, Quebecor’s Videotron subsidiary acquired Freedom Mobile from Shaw. Rogers and Shaw agreed to sell Freedom to Videotron for $2.85 billion in an attempt to ease competition concerns raised by the original proposal. Both of those transactions came with a list conditions meant to protect competition in the telecom sector. They included Rogers establishing a second headquarters in Calgary and adding 3,000 new jobs based in Western Canada that it must maintain for at least 10 years. Rogers was also required to spend billions to expand 5G coverage and additional network services, as well as to connect rural, remote and Indigenous communities. Videotron was required to offer plans at least 20 per cent lower than its competitors and spend $150 million over two years to upgrade Freedom Mobile’s network. It is also restricted from transferring any Freedom Mobile licences for a decade. Quebecor said that it “has fully performed the undertakings it made” to Ottawa since that deal, while demonstrating its ability “to combine growth, pro-consumer pricing and innovation.”  It noted that wireless prices fell 35.4 per cent in the three years following the acquisition of Freedom, according to Statistics Canada. “Providing Canadians with a stronger competitor, capable of investing more, while continuing to offer wider choice, including by maintaining the Telus brands, as well as healthy competition and real value, will remain at the core of the combined company’s DNA,” Quebecor said. Combining two of Canada’s four largest wireless service providers “would undo the competitive structure regulators set up when they required Freedom to be divested as part of the Rogers-Shaw approval,” Scotiabank’s Yaghi said in a note. “Without meaningful remedies, the deal runs against the government policy intent behind the Freedom transaction,” he said, adding that approval could be contingent on Quebecor offering “significant concessions to the government” to keep telecom prices low. “Regulatory decisions will make or break the deal, not price. If Quebecor is not ready to let go of Freedom Mobile, we believe this deal has a low chance of going through.” Quebecor’s share price fell about 14 per cent or $10.44 to $66.62 in morning trading. Telus’ share price jumped about 12 per cent or $1.46 to $13.60. --- Sammy Hudes, The Canadian Press This report by The Canadian Press was first published Nov. 16, 2026.

items.title: Morgan Stanley rebaja a Brasil y revela sus apuestas en América Latina para 2027
items.author: Juan Pablo Álvarez
items.summary: Morgan Stanley rebajó su recomendación sobre las acciones brasileñas y favorece a Chile y Perú de cara a 2027. El banco también identifica oportunidades en el sector energético argentino y mantiene un ...
items.body: Morgan Stanley ( MS ) cambió sus apuestas para el mercado accionario de América Latina de cara a 2027. El banco estadounidense rebajó su recomendación sobre Brasil de neutral a infraponderar (underweight), ante los riesgos fiscales y las perspectivas de ganancias empresariales, mientras mantiene una posición neutral sobre México y favorece a los mercados andinos más pequeños, especialmente Chile y Perú. La entidad también identifica oportunidades en el sector energético argentino, en un contexto de mayores inversiones en petróleo y minerales. Su estrategia para la región apunta a seleccionar sectores y compañías, en lugar de apostar por mercados nacionales en su conjunto. En su informe de perspectivas para 2027, el equipo encabezado por Nikolaj Lippmann mantiene una visión positiva sobre América Latina, respaldada por el ciclo global de inversión en inteligencia artificial (IA), aunque advierte que el desempeño será desigual entre países. Morgan Stanley proyecta un retorno de 7% en dólares para las acciones latinoamericanas hacia finales de 2027. Sin embargo, las diferencias son significativas: estima un potencial de apreciación de 35% para Argentina y de 32% para Chile, frente a caídas de 5% para Brasil y de 6% para Colombia. VER MÁS: ¿Por qué se disparan las acciones de CoreWeave? Las claves según BofA y Morgan Stanley Chile figura entre los mercados favoritos de Morgan Stanley para 2027. Su recomendación de sobreponderar ( overweight ) se sustenta en el papel del país como proveedor estratégico de cobre y litio, dos minerales cuya demanda podría aumentar con la expansión de los centros de datos y la infraestructura vinculada con la inteligencia artificial. El país produce aproximadamente una cuarta parte del cobre mundial y cuenta con una cartera creciente de proyectos de infraestructura y energía. Según el banco, estas inversiones podrían impulsar una transición hacia un crecimiento económico más apoyado en la formación de capital. A ello se suman las expectativas de reformas bajo la administración de José Antonio Kast, incluidas iniciativas legislativas y cambios en el mercado de capitales que podrían mejorar el entorno de negocios y profundizar el mercado financiero local. En este contexto, Morgan Stanley elevó su precio objetivo para el IPSA a 13.400 puntos hacia finales de 2027, desde los 12.900 puntos anteriores. La nueva estimación representa un potencial de apreciación de 32% en dólares. Entre los principales riesgos, el banco menciona la dependencia de Chile de las importaciones de petróleo y la posibilidad de que las reformas no avancen al ritmo esperado por el mercado. Perú también figura entre las apuestas preferidas de la entidad, dentro de una estrategia que privilegia a los mercados andinos más pequeños y su exposición a minerales estratégicos y al ciclo global de inversión. No obstante, el informe no presenta un objetivo de rendimiento para Perú comparable con el de Chile. En Argentina, Morgan Stanley identifica oportunidades particularmente en el sector energético, ante el avance de las inversiones en petróleo y minerales y el potencial de nuevos proyectos para impulsar la actividad de las compañías locales. El informe señala que el Régimen de Incentivo para Grandes Inversiones (RIGI) acumula 27 proyectos aprobados por US$76.200 millones, además de otros 21 proyectos por US$133.000 millones que permanecen en evaluación. Entre las iniciativas destacadas figura el oleoducto Vaca Muerta Oil Sur (VMOS), cuya construcción, según el informe, superaba el 85% de avance. El proyecto apuntaba a iniciar operaciones el 31 de diciembre de 2026, con las primeras exportaciones previstas para el primer trimestre de 2027. Morgan Stanley estima que las acciones argentinas podrían registrar una apreciación de 35% en dólares hacia finales de 2027, el mayor potencial entre los mercados mencionados en sus proyecciones regionales. Sin embargo, el banco advierte que el mercado de capitales argentino todavía presenta limitaciones de profundidad y credibilidad, lo que restringe su capacidad para financiar internamente un ciclo de inversión de mayor escala. La entidad también identifica las elecciones presidenciales de 2027 como un factor de riesgo, debido a la importancia de la continuidad de las políticas económicas para sostener el proceso de reequilibrio macroeconómico. Por estas razones, recomienda mantener un optimismo cauteloso sobre las acciones argentinas. Brasil concentra el principal cambio de estrategia de Morgan Stanley para 2027. El banco redujo su recomendación sobre las acciones brasileñas de neutral a infraponderar, ante una combinación de riesgos macroeconómicos y factores propios del mercado. La entidad identifica cinco elementos detrás de la decisión: la ausencia de un marco fiscal claro, el riesgo de revisiones a la baja en las ganancias empresariales, las valuaciones, la salida de inversionistas locales de la renta variable y la diversificación de capitales hacia activos internacionales. Según sus estimaciones, las ganancias de las compañías brasileñas enfrentan un riesgo de revisión a la baja de entre 10% y 20%. A ello se suma la salida de capitales locales del mercado accionario, que el banco calcula entre US$10.000 millones y US$12.000 millones anuales. Las elevadas tasas de interés representan otro obstáculo, al encarecer el financiamiento y reducir los incentivos para invertir en acciones. En este escenario, Morgan Stanley proyecta una caída de 5% en dólares para el Ibovespa hacia finales de 2027. No obstante, la recomendación de infraponderar el mercado brasileño no implica una visión negativa sobre todas sus compañías. El banco mantiene su preferencia por exportadores y empresas de gran capitalización, con ingresos en dólares, exposición a flujos internacionales y retornos sobre el capital superiores a su costo. Morgan Stanley mantiene su recomendación neutral ( equal-weight ) sobre las acciones mexicanas, aunque proyecta un rendimiento de 15% en dólares para el índice MEXBOL hacia finales de 2027. El banco fijó un precio objetivo de 80.000 puntos, frente a los 71.894 puntos utilizados como referencia en el informe. Uno de los factores que respaldan esta perspectiva es el potencial de mayores compras por parte de los fondos de pensiones locales. Las administradoras de fondos para el retiro (AFORE) destinan actualmente el 6,5% de sus activos a acciones mexicanas, por debajo del 9% registrado en 2012. Morgan Stanley estima que las compras netas de estos fondos podrían rondar los US$2.500 millones, con margen para acercarse a US$3.500 millones hacia 2030, impulsadas por la reforma previsional. En cuanto a los resultados empresariales, proyecta un crecimiento de las ganancias por acción en dólares de 8% en 2027 y de 5% en 2028. El banco también prevé que el múltiplo precio-beneficio esperado a 12 meses aumente de 13 a 13,2 veces. Las perspectivas de Morgan Stanley para el mercado accionario colombiano son menos favorables. El banco estableció un objetivo de 2.400 puntos para el COLCAP hacia finales de 2027, frente a los 2.528 puntos de referencia utilizados en su informe. Esto representa una caída proyectada de 5% en moneda local y de 6% en dólares. Las estimaciones de ganancias empresariales también muestran una desaceleración. Morgan Stanley anticipa un crecimiento de 10% en dólares para 2027, seguido de una contracción de 13% en 2028. En materia de valuaciones, proyecta que el múltiplo precio-beneficio esperado a 12 meses pase de 8,4 a 8,5 veces. Aunque Colombia no figura entre los mercados preferidos del banco para 2027, sus proyecciones de rendimiento negativo no equivalen necesariamente a una recomendación formal de infraponderar sus acciones. Más allá de las diferencias entre mercados, Morgan Stanley considera que América Latina está bien posicionada para beneficiarse del ciclo global de inversión en inteligencia artificial. Sin embargo, la principal oportunidad no estaría necesariamente en atraer grandes desembolsos para infraestructura tecnológica, sino en suministrar los recursos que demanda su expansión, como energía, cobre, otros minerales estratégicos y hardware. El banco destaca que América Latina aporta entre el 10% y el 20% de la oferta mundial de energía y cerca del 30% de la producción global de cobre. Chile figura entre los países mejor posicionados por su liderazgo en cobre y litio, mientras que otros mercados podrían aprovechar la demanda de recursos naturales y componentes vinculados con la infraestructura tecnológica. La adopción de inteligencia artificial también comienza a reflejarse en la actividad de las compañías latinoamericanas. De las 170 empresas analizadas por Morgan Stanley, el 39% mencionó esta tecnología durante sus llamadas de resultados del segundo trimestre de 2026, frente al 65% de las compañías del S&P 500. El banco espera que los beneficios para las empresas de la región provengan principalmente de mejoras de productividad, eficiencia operativa y reducción de costos, más que de un incremento significativo en sus inversiones de capital. Entre las compañías que identifica como primeras adoptantes de estas tecnologías figuran Nubank, Grupo Financiero Banorte y MercadoLibre. VER MÁS: Morgan Stanley: bonos argentinos ya descuentan un 50% de probabilidad de un escenario bajista tras las elecciones La adopción de inteligencia artificial también presenta diferencias entre países. Según una encuesta citada por el banco, el 54% de los trabajadores brasileños que realizan tareas de oficina utiliza herramientas de IA diariamente, frente al 38% en México. Para Morgan Stanley, las ganancias de productividad podrían comenzar a materializarse en las empresas de servicios, especialmente en bancos y plataformas digitales.

items.title: Canaccord Genuity selling British wealth management business, signs go-private deal
items.author: The Canadian Press
items.summary: Canaccord Genuity Group Inc. has signed a deal to sell its wealth management business in the United Kingdom and become a private company.
items.body: TORONTO — Canaccord Genuity Group Inc. has signed a deal to sell its wealth management business in the United Kingdom and become a private company. Under the agreement, private equity investors Centerbridge Partners LP and Mubadala Investment Co. PJSC will buy the British wealth management operations in a deal that values the business at about 1.17 billion pounds. Meanwhile, a company led by Canaccord Genuity chair and CEO Dan Daviau will acquire the rest of the company’s business in a go-private transaction. Canaccord Genuity shareholders are expected to receive a cash payment of $7.45 per share, plus 4.15 pounds per share from the sale of wealth management business in the United Kingdom. The company valued the total offer at $15.27 per share, based on the exchange rates on Friday. It said the sale of the British wealth management business is expected to go ahead regardless of the completion of the go-private transaction. Shares of Canaccord were trading up one per cent at $14.97 at midday Monday. --- This report by The Canadian Press was first published Nov. 16, 2026.

Nov 16 : Crystal Palace have appointed Thomas Frank as manager on a contract until June 2029, the Premier League club said on Monday.
Frank takes charge after the dismissal of Pierre Sage, whose five-month spell in charge ended after 16 games with the side at the bottom of the table.
"Crystal Palace is an iconic club in England and in the Premier League. I will do everything I possibly can to help and support the players and everyone around the place, and I'm really looking forward to meeting them,” Frank said in a statement.
Palace have not won a league match since October 11, with a 5-0 defeat by Brighton & Hove Albion triggering the slump that dragged them into the relegation battle.

Their recent 3-1 home defeat by Liverpool extended their losing streak to four Premier League matches, leaving the south London club bottom of the standings and two points from safety.
Frank arrives at struggling Selhurst Park taking on his first managerial role since being sacked by Tottenham Hotspur following an eight-month spell in charge.
The 53-year-old's move to Tottenham turned sour as a woeful run of results left the club hovering above the relegation zone.
He joined the club in June 2025 as successor to Ange Postecoglou but was dismissed in February this year, after leaving the North London club in 16th place with 29 points from 26 matches.
Before moving to Tottenham, the Dane enjoyed a successful seven-year stint at Brentford between 2018 and 2025, guiding the club to the Premier League and establishing them in the top flight, with a ninth-placed finish in 2022-23 their highest league position under his leadership.
Frank began his coaching career with Denmark's under-age sides before taking charge at Brondby in 2013. He left in March 2016 and joined Brentford in December that year as assistant to Dean Smith in the Championship before taking the head coach role in 2018.

items.title: トランプ氏、ラトニック商務長官の更迭計画なし　訪中も同行
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Steve Holland

[ワシントン １６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Steve Holland

[ワシントン １６日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は１６日、ラトニック商務長官を解任する考えはないと表明した。

ラトニック長官を巡っては、米半導体大手エヌビディアのジェンセン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）の辞任に伴い、中国向け人工知能（ＡＩ）半導体の輸出規制への対応が不十分だったとして批判が高まっている。ロイターは先週、ホワイトハウス高官らが同長官の更迭の是非について協議していると報じていた。

フアン氏は、中国のスパイとみられる女性らとの不倫疑惑が取り沙汰される中、１２日に辞任した。同女性はシンガポール企業メガスピードの元幹部で中国人実業家のアリス・フアン氏。米情報機関は、同氏が中国企業向けのエヌビディア製半導体の流通を支援していたとみている。

トランプ大統領はアジア歴訪への出発を前に記者団に対し、ラトニック長官について「非常に良い仕事をしている」と評価した。同長官への信頼を維持しているかとの質問には「その通りだ」と答え、更迭する計画はないとした。

ホワイトハウス当局者によると、ラトニック長官はトランプ大統領に同行して中国を訪問する予定。

items.summary: [モスクワ　１６日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[モスクワ　１６日　ロイター] -  ロシアのウシャコフ大統領補佐官（外交担当）は１６日、中国で１９日に予定されている米国、中国、ロシア３カ国の首脳会談について、会談後に発表する共同声明の文言を巡り、集中的な協議が進められていると明らかにした。

ウシャコフ氏は、３カ国首脳会談後に共同声明が発表されると期待しているとした上で、共同声明がまとまらなかった場合でも、各首脳が会談についてそれぞれ見解を示すとの見方を示した。

３首脳は中国広東省深圳市で開かれるアジア太平洋経済協力会議（ＡＰＥＣ）首脳会議に参加する際に会談する。ウシャコフ氏によると、会談は中国の習近平国家主席の公邸で行われる。

ウシャコフ氏は「こうした首脳会談は初めてで、重要性と象徴的な意味合いをいくら強調してもし過ぎることはない」とし、会談では第２次世界大戦での勝利や国連創設に対する各国の貢献が考慮されるとしたほか、会談の結果は世界情勢に大きな影響を及ぼすとの見方を示した。

ウシャコフ氏によると、プーチン氏は１８日に習主席と会談する。協議では２国間の経済協力の展望に加え、ウクライナ情勢や朝鮮半島情勢が主要議題になるという。プーチン氏とトランプ米大統領の会談については、１９日の実施に向けて調整が進められていると明らかにした。両首脳が会談することは確実だが、形式や開催場所については最終調整中としている。

また、プーチン大統領のＡＰＥＣ首脳会議出席に関連し、ガスプロム、ノバテク、ロスネフチ、ルクオイル、ズベルバンク、ヤンデックス、ワイルドベリーズを含む３０社を超えるロシア企業が参加すると明らかにした。

SAN FRANCISCO, Nov 16 : Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh said on Monday that emerging technologies will have a significant impact on the economy, but the possible scenarios range from rising growth with broadly shared gains to higher unemployment and a potential slowdown if anticipated investment returns prove disappointing.
Warsh refers to artificial intelligence as "super intelligence," the language preferred by President Donald Trump, and said it could prove distinct from earlier technologies as a force to "supercharge idea generation."
In the best scenario, Warsh said in remarks prepared for delivery at a Fed conference on AI in San Francisco, the technology could lead "to an increase in productivity and economic gains that are shared broadly across labor and the owners of capital. In that event, real GDP growth rises persistently above its long-run average, and the US stays close to full employment."
But Warsh said the risks, including higher unemployment and the use of AI by "bad actors," could also be "highly disruptive and economically costly."

"Our job is to prepare for whatever comes next," he said of the Fed's convening of a group of AI experts to explore the implications of the technology for the economy and central banking.
"Our role in all this is neither advocacy nor opposition. Our responsibility is to recognize that the widespread adoption of this technology will have significant impact on the economy, with important implications for monetary policy down the road," Warsh said. "The big questions are about magnitude, scope, and timing."

Source: Reuters

items.title: カナダ中銀総裁、27年6月に任期満了で退任へ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [オタワ １６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[オタワ １６日 ロイター] -  カナダ銀行（中央銀行）のマックレム総裁は１６日、予定通り２０２７年６月に任期満了で退任すると発表した。新型コロナウイルスのパンデミック（世界的大流行）、米国の関税、イラン紛争への対応に追われた７年間の任期を終える。

マックレム氏は６５歳。退任は広く予想されていた。同中銀の総裁が２期目を務めた最後の例は１９８０年だった。

カナダ中銀は後任総裁を探す委員会を設置し、２７年春までに選考を終える見通しだとした。

エコノミストによると、経歴などから見ればキャロリン・ロジャース上級副総裁が有力候補となる。ただ、カナダ中銀は０１年以降、過去４回の総裁人事で外部の候補を起用している。女性が総裁に就いた例はない。

誰が後任になっても、政策の大幅な変更を推し進める可能性は低いとみられる。中銀と財務省は、インフレ率を２％前後に維持することを柱とする５年間の金融政策の枠組みを更新したばかりだ。

items.title: TC Energy plans to grow Alberta pipeline network to serve oilsands, power plants
items.author: The Canadian Press
items.summary: TC Energy Corp. has announced plans to expand its Alberta natural gas pipeline network to get more supply to the oilsands region.
items.body: CALGARY — TC Energy Corp. has announced plans to expand its Alberta natural gas pipeline network to get more supply to the oilsands region. It’s proposing a roughly 370-kilometre, 48-inch west-to-east pipeline called Alberta Growth Connector, which would add an initial one billion cubic feet per day of new capacity. That project would be part of a broader plan to grow its NGTL system, which has been in operation for almost 70 years and forms a vast web stretching throughout Alberta and into northeastern British Columbia. TC is projecting total demand on NGTL will increase by about a quarter to 18 billion cubic feet per day in 2031. More than 60 per cent of the forecast increase is expected to come from the oilsands, power generation and data centres. The growth plan could also include additional pipeline loops and compressor units to boost throughput on the existing system. “Our approach is deliberate and disciplined: leverage our existing infrastructure, align investment with customer commitments and advance projects that meet our risk and return requirements,” chief executive François Poirier said in a news release Monday. --- Lauren Krugel, The Canadian Press This report by The Canadian Press was first published Nov. 16, 2026.

FAST

Nov 16 : Trump Media & Technology Group faces a possible $1 billion cash demand from convertible debt holders this month, putting pressure on the Truth Social parent as its shares trade near record lows and more than half its assets are digital assets.
The $1 billion in convertible notes, issued in May 2025, mature in 2028, but holders can demand cash repayment on November 30, according to company filings. The notes convert into shares at $34.72, well above the current price.
Trump Media shares were last down 9.5 per cent at $4.20, close to their record low of $3.80 hit earlier this month. The stock has lost more than two-thirds of its value so far this year.
As of September 30, the company had more than $2.47 billion in total assets, roughly 55 per cent of which, or about $1.36 billion, were digital assets. Trump Media holds only two tokens, bitcoin and Crypto.com's native token cronos.

The concentration in digital assets could complicate any cash repayment if crypto prices remain under pressure. Bitcoin was last at $64,505.20, down almost 50 per cent from its October peak, while the cronos token was down 52.4 per cent so far this year, according to CoinGecko data.
The company said in its latest quarterly filing that it would fund any repayment from cash, asset sales, revenue or new equity or debt, and may refinance through a new credit facility.
It said paying holders in stock would not be sensible with shares far below the conversion price, unless the notes require it.
Trump Media did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment.

Nov 16 : Trump Media & Technology Group faces a possible $1 billion cash demand from convertible debt holders this month, putting pressure on the Truth Social parent as its shares trade near record lows and more than half its assets are digital assets.
The $1 billion in convertible notes, issued in May 2025, mature in 2028, but holders can demand cash repayment on November 30, according to company filings. The notes convert into shares at $34.72, well above the current price.
Trump Media shares were last down 9.5 per cent at $4.20, close to their record low of $3.80 hit earlier this month. The stock has lost more than two-thirds of its value so far this year.
As of September 30, the company had more than $2.47 billion in total assets, roughly 55 per cent of which, or about $1.36 billion, were digital assets. Trump Media holds only two tokens, bitcoin and Crypto.com's native token cronos.

items.author: The Canadian Press
items.summary: The Bank of Canada says Tiff Macklem will not seek a second term as governor and plans to step down when his current run expires on June 2, 2027.
items.body: OTTAWA — The Bank of Canada says Tiff Macklem will not seek a second term as governor and plans to step down when his current run expires on June 2, 2027.    The central bank’s board of directors says it has started a search process to select the next governor. “It has been the highlight of my career to serve as the 10th governor of the Bank of Canada,” Macklem said in a news release Monday. He said his tenure has come as Canada navigates a world that is more fragmented and shock-prone. “The bank has faced these challenges by acting decisively, by using sound judgment in the face of uncertainty, and by serving Canadians with humility and a steadfast commitment to its mandate,” he said.  Macklem was named governor in May 2020 and took over the job in June of that year, during the early days of the pandemic. The central bank said the recruitment process is expected to be completed by spring 2027. The board’s choice will be subject to approval by the minister of finance and the federal cabinet. --- This report by The Canadian Press was first published Nov. 16, 2026.

items.title: RBI reiterates listing mandate for Tata Sons, seeks compliance with norms
items.author: Subrata Panda
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has reiterated that Tata Sons must comply with all regulatory requirements applicable to upper-layer non-banking financial companies (NBFCs), including the mandatory ...
items.body: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has reiterated that Tata Sons must comply with all regulatory requirements applicable to upper-layer non-banking financial companies (NBFCs), including the mandatory stock market listing, in a communication to the Tata group holding company dated November 16. In a letter addressed to Tata Sons’ chief financial officer, the central bank referred to the company’s October 6 communication seeking regulatory guidance to ensure compliance with applicable regulations. The RBI said while Tata Sons had not sought clarification on any specific regulation or guideline, its request appeared to relate to the discussions at the company’s board regarding listing. “In this connection, you are advised to comply with all applicable regulations/ guidelines/ directions, issued by the RBI in respect of NBFCs in the Upper Layer (NBFC-UL), as stipulated in extant regulations/ guidelines/ directions hosted on the RBI’s website, including the requirement of listing by your company,” the letter said. The latest communication reinforces the regulator’s position on the listing of Tata Sons, which has remained unlisted despite the September 30, 2025, deadline prescribed for upper-layer NBFCs. The development assumes significance, coming ahead of Tata Sons board meeting on November 26. The November 16 letter follows the RBI’s September 11 decision to reject Tata Sons’ application seeking voluntary surrender of its registration as a core investment company (CIC). The rejection effectively closed the company’s principal regulatory route to exit the NBFC framework and avoid the listing requirement. Tata Sons had approached the RBI in March 2024 seeking deregistration after repaying all its debt. The company had sought to move out of the regulatory framework applicable to upper-layer NBFCs, which would have allowed it to remain privately held. However, the RBI rejected the application after examining the various aspects of the request and subsequently directed the company to comply with the regulations applicable to upper-layer NBFCs. Tata Sons was first classified as an upper-layer NBFC in September 2022 under the RBI’s scale-based regulatory framework. Entities classified in this category are subject to enhanced regulatory requirements, including mandatory listing within three years of their classification. Under the revised framework, NBFCs with assets of ₹1 trillion or more qualify for upper-layer classification. Tata Sons reported total assets of around ₹2.01 trillion as of March 31, 2026, placing it well above the prescribed threshold. The RBI had also retained Tata Sons in its list of upper-layer NBFCs for 2026-27, published this August, clarifying that its inclusion was without prejudice to the outcome of the company’s deregistration application, which was under examination at that time. Tata Trusts, which collectively control around 66 per cent of Tata Sons, have favoured retaining the holding company as a privately held entity. On the other hand, the Shapoorji Pallonji group, which holds around 18.37 per cent, has favoured a listing as a potential route to unlock value from its investment and facilitate fundraising against its stake.

Nov 16 : Rassie Erasmus has defended his decision to change his entire front row hours before South Africa’s Nations Championship defeat by France on Friday, and did not rule out making more late changes when they meet Ireland in Dublin on Saturday.
Erasmus had originally named props Ox Nche and Wilco Louw, and hooker Malcolm Marx, to start against the French, but having seen the side their opponents picked, dropped the trio to the bench, bringing them on late in the first half.
The Springboks have taken to naming their match-day 23 early in the week, and several times Erasmus has made changes closer to the match once the opposition team is named, as he is allowed to do.  
"We saw the team France had selected and looked at the players we were going to face," Erasmus told reporters after naming his team for Ireland on Monday.

"We probably could have made the changes when they announced their side on Thursday, but the regulations allow you to change the team the following morning before the game.
"We thought, 'Let's get Jan-Hendrik Wessels, Thomas du Toit and Gerhard Steenekamp out there'. Maybe we'll need them next year at the (2027 Rugby) World Cup, under pressure, starting a big test match for us against one of the best scrummaging packs.
"That was the thinking behind it. We wanted to expose those guys to that pressure and give them that experience."
While not against World Rugby regulations, some have questioned whether late changes are within the spirit of the game.
"If people are going to keep getting upset about it, then I apologise," Erasmus said. "But I'm not apologising for doing it. I'm apologising because you're probably going to keep getting upset about it!.
"If Ireland name a side on Thursday and that we didn’t think they were going to play, we might make some changes."

Nov 16 : US men's national team coach Mauricio Pochettino insisted on Monday that his focus was not divided ahead of his departure for Manchester United, as he prepares to coach the American side for the last time on Tuesday.
The Argentine signed a contract to lead the US through to the 2030 World Cup but last week agreed to take the helm at the Premier League club.
Pochettino will have little time before his first game with United, joining them on Wednesday with the team due to play arch-rivals Liverpool on Sunday at Anfield, and his decision to stay with the US for their CONCACAF fixture against Haiti has been criticised.
"For me, it's not difficult. I think we are well prepared to switch quick - like a player, from the national team to the clubs. From one game that you don't play well to another that you need to be ready again. From one action to the next action," Pochettino told reporters ahead of the US match in Cincinnati.

Manchester United are bidding to get out of the relegation zone with Pochettino, who improved a US men's team who have long trailed their female counterparts in terms of on-field success. 
He led the Americans to the 2025 Gold Cup final, where they lost to Mexico, and steered them to the final 16 of the World Cup this year on home soil.
Pochettino has sent members of his coaching staff ahead of him to Manchester to prepare for his arrival. 
"That was the plan when we agreed terms with Manchester United and with the national team," he said. "They are preparing all there because Wednesday, when we will arrive, it's going to be non-stop."

items.title: トランプ氏の仮想通貨「＄トランプ」急落、夕食会への関心冷え込み
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Michelle Conlin　Tom Bergin

[ニューヨーク １６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Michelle Conlin　Tom Bergin

[ニューヨーク １６日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領の公式暗号資産（仮想通貨）「＄トランプ」の購入者を招待する第３回夕食会の当選者が１６日に決定されつつある中、同通貨の取引価格は０．９２ドル前後で推移しており、２０２５年の最高値である７４ドル超から大幅に下落している。

「＄トランプ」は２５年４月、同通貨の購入額上位２２０人をトランプ氏とのプライベート夕食会に招待するとの発表を受け、一時６０％超急騰。富裕な暗号資産投資家らは、トランプ氏が「世界で最も独占的な招待」と宣伝する中、計１億４８００万ドルを投じた。

しかし、１１月２２日に首都郊外にあるトランプ大統領のゴルフクラブで開催予定の第３回夕食会への関心は冷え込んでいる。今回のコンテストでは、「＄トランプ」の保有者１８５人を招待し、９月３０日─１１月１６日のコンテスト集計期間中に最も保有量の多かった人を競うことになっていたが、締め切り時点のリーダーボードには、わずか１３０の暗号資産ウォレットしか表示されず、合計保有額は８６０万ドルと、第１回目の夕食会から９４％減少した。

コンテストのウェブサイトによると、上位２９のウォレットには、ディナーでのＶＩＰ席とともに、「あなたの大好きな大統領」との「特別ＶＩＰレセプション」の特典が贈られる。

オランダ出身の暗号資産起業家モーテン・クリステンセン氏は「世界でも最も影響力のある人物の一人と言える米国大統領と同じ部屋にいられる」とし、「参加するのにほとんど費用がかからないのに、行かない理由があるだろうか」と述べた。同氏にとって、夕食会の参加資格を得るのはこれで３回目だが、大統領とのＶＩＰレセプションに出席するのはこれが初めてだという。同氏は時間加重で約４万１０００ドル相当の「＄トランプ」を保有し、リーダーボードで２６位にランクインした。

トランプ一族のその他の暗号資産関連株や事業も過去最低水準に縮小している。ロイターの推計によると、主要な５つの暗号資産・暗号資産関連プロジェクトの外部投資家は、合計で５０億ドル超を失った。

これら損失の大半は、トランプ氏率いる共和党が民主党に惨敗した中間選挙前に生じたもので、この結果を受けて価格はさらに下落した。

トランプ・ミームコイン・プロジェクトとトランプ・オーガニゼーションは、コメントの要請に応じなかった。ホワイトハウスもコメントの要請に応じなかったが、トランプ大統領の資産は子どもたちが運営する信託に置かれているため利益相反はないと繰り返し主張している。

WASHINGTON: US President Donald Trump said on Monday (Nov 16) he might meet with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un in China this week, an anno un cement that could dramatically reshape his upcoming trip through East Asia if it occurs .
Th e president, who met t he North Korean leader several times during his 2017-2021 term, including once in t he Korean Demilitarised Zone, has previously expressed interest in anot he r meet ing during his current term. Senior US officials, however, have previously said he has no immediate plans to do so.
Moreover, Trump has repeatedly previewed meet ings with Kim that never took place, including during a trip to Asia last year. North Korea, whose mission to t he Un ited Nations did not immediately respond to a request for comment, has publicly indicated it has no intention of meet ing with t he US president at this time.
Trump told reporters while departing t he White House en route to t he Philippines and China that any meet ing would occur in China , and that t he North Korean leader's presence was ultimately up to Chinese President Xi Jinping.

Trump has indicated he will meet with Putin and Xi during his trip, but US officials and analysts have played down t he possibility of a meaningful agreement emerging from any trilateral sit-down .

PARIS, Nov 16 : Philippe Diallo stepped into the race to unseat Gianni Infantino as FIFA president on Monday, but the French football chief begins with a limited show of European support that leaves the incumbent the clear favourite to secure another four years.
The endorsement was emphatic but carefully bounded: the national associations represented on UEFA’s executive committee and FIFA Council unanimously backed Diallo, but UEFA stopped short of claiming support from all 55 members.
People familiar with the matter told Reuters on Monday that Diallo, 63, does not yet have the backing of all 55.
In backing Diallo, the associations cast their choice as a call to reset FIFA’s course: rebuild trust, put the game’s development in every region first, uphold the highest standards of governance and work in closer partnership with football’s members and stakeholders.

They said they had full confidence in Diallo to provide that leadership. He has accepted their invitation, with his candidacy due to be ratified by the French Football Federation’s executive committee on Tuesday.
The 56-year-old Infantino may be favourite to win in March, but the ballot could prove the easier contest. A tougher test may be waiting in Washington, where Democrats are set to take control of the House of Representatives in January.
People familiar with the matter told Reuters they expect scrutiny of Infantino’s relationship with the Trump administration to intensify once the party takes over congressional committees.
Democratic lawmakers have already sought information about Infantino’s relationship with President Donald Trump. A House majority would give them the power to investigate and compel testimony, opening a new front for the FIFA president even if he wins comfortably at the ballot box.
That prospect comes as Infantino is still dealing with the fallout from FIFA Forward Enterprise (FFE), his abandoned plan to sell stakes to private investors in FIFA’s commercial assets.
The proposal provoked fierce criticism over governance and transparency, drew widespread opposition and prompted legal action to obtain documents. Infantino dropped the plan.
The Swiss, who took charge in 2016, apologised over the handling of the FFE project at a FIFA Council meeting in Zurich in October.
UEFA has led the opposition to Infantino since the FFE proposal.
ALTERNATIVE CANDIDATE
Diallo became UEFA's alternative candidate after Arsene Wenger, FIFA’s chief of global football development, declined to run, people familiar with the discussions told Reuters.
Wenger had looked a more credible challenger, with the international profile to attract support beyond Europe. Diallo, who withdrew his backing for Infantino earlier this year, was the candidate left to carry the challenge.
The French federation president has built experience across the game. Before taking over the FFF and joining UEFA’s executive committee in 2023, he led the organisation representing French professional clubs, served on the French professional league’s board and worked within FIFA’s dispute-resolution structures.
FIFA’s election is a numbers game in which every one of its 211 member associations gets the same vote, whatever its size or commercial clout. Even a united UEFA would command only just over a quarter of the electorate, so any challenger needs to find substantial support in Africa, Asia and the Americas.
Infantino has spent a decade building ties with national federations, particularly outside Europe, through increased development funding and a bigger calendar of competitions.
His supporters say he has increased FIFA’s revenue and channelled more money to smaller associations. His critics accuse him of concentrating power and eroding the checks on his presidency.
Diallo’s challenge is to turn European backing into a coalition that can travel across continents.
Infantino, for now, can campaign as the clear favourite, while preparing for the possibility that his next term brings a sharper fight over his record in Washington.

Source: Reuters

items.title: Trump: Huang Didn't Put National Security at Risk (Full Remarks)
items.summary:
President Donald Trump supported calls for Jensen Huang’s reinstatement as Nvidia’s chief executive officer and downplayed national security concerns about the ousted executive’s relationship with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy.

“I would not mind that,” Trump told reporters Monday at the White House before leaving for his trip to Asia, when asked about the possibility of Huang returning as CEO. “A lot of people are asking Jensen, they think Jensen should go back. That certainly isn’t a bad idea.”

“We’ll meet with President Xi. He was here a month ago, and we’re also going to meet with President Putin, and we may meet with Kim Jong Un also,” Trump told reporters. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Warren Buffett donará US$5.500 millones en acciones de Berkshire a fundaciones familiares
items.author: Sophie Alex, er, Am, a Cantrell
items.summary: El presidente emérito de Berkshire Hathaway distribuirá 9,23 millones de acciones de clase B entre las fundaciones de sus tres hijos y la organización que lleva el nombre de su difunta esposa.
items.body: Bloomberg — Warren Buffett, presidente emérito de Berkshire Hathaway Inc. ( BRK/A ), donará acciones de su empresa por valor de US$5.500 millones a cuatro fundaciones vinculadas a su familia. Según un comunicado emitido este lunes, Buffett donará aproximadamente US$1.100 millones a cada una de las fundaciones de sus tres hijos mayores y otros US$2.200 millones a la Fundación Susan Thompson Buffett, que lleva el nombre de su difunta esposa. Las donaciones consisten en 9,23 millones de acciones de clase B de Berkshire. Buffett, de 96 años, anunció en julio que tenía previsto deshacerse de su enorme participación en la empresa a lo largo de los próximos ocho años. También afirmó en aquel momento que no continuaría con sus donaciones a la Fundación Gates, dirigida por su viejo amigo Bill Gates. Ver más: Warren Buffett: ¿por qué Berkshire Hathaway no ha pagado dividendos en unos 60 años? Esto se produjo tras la publicación de una gran cantidad de documentos por parte del Departamento de Justicia de Estados Unidos que reavivó el escrutinio sobre los vínculos de Gates con Jeffrey Epstein. Este lunes es solo la segunda vez en dos décadas que Buffett ha anunciado una donación benéfica sin que nada se destine a la Fundación Gates, que en su día desempeñó un papel fundamental en los planes filantrópicos del multimillonario. En su lugar, Buffett ha trasladado la responsabilidad de sus donaciones a sus hijos. “Mis hijos llevan décadas realizando donaciones meditadas a causas dignas, y confío al 100% tanto en sus capacidades como en su fidelidad”, afirmó Buffett en el comunicado del lunes, añadiendo que confía en el futuro de Berkshire. Buffett y su difunta esposa crearon fundaciones para cada uno de sus hijos hace casi tres décadas: la Fundación Sherwood de Susie, la Fundación Howard G. Buffett de Howard y la Fundación NoVo de Peter. Susie, Howard y Peter tienen ahora entre 60 y 70 años. Ver más: Warren Buffett: las 10 acciones clave que dominan su portafolio de inversión A medida que Buffett intenta vaciar sus arcas, una parte mayor de sus acciones de Berkshire se destinará a la fundación que lleva el nombre de su difunta esposa, dirigida por el exmarido de su hija. Tras su fallecimiento, todo lo que quede pasará a manos de sus hijos, quienes deberán ponerse de acuerdo por unanimidad sobre cómo gastarlo. Podrían seguir distribuyéndolo entre las fundaciones familiares o ponerlo en común para dedicarlo a alguna otra causa o causas. En entrevistas concedidas este año, los tres hijos expresaron su incertidumbre sobre el futuro de la histórica fortuna de su padre. Sus organizaciones sin ánimo de lucro se centran actualmente en áreas de interés para cada uno de ellos: la educación infantil para Susie, la seguridad alimentaria y la mitigación de conflictos para Howard, y el apoyo a las comunidades marginadas para Peter. Aunque las donaciones de Buffett a las fundaciones de su familia este Día de Acción de Gracias son más de cuatro veces superiores a las del año pasado, tendrá que acelerar considerablemente el ritmo si desea alcanzar su objetivo en ocho años. Tras el anuncio de hoy, sus acciones restantes tienen un valor de más de US$162.000 millones—la gran mayoría de su fortuna de US$168.400 millones, según el Índice de Multimillonarios de Bloomberg—. ANTALYA, Turkey, Nov 16 : The 403 hyperscale data centers currently operating around the US emit as much greenhouse gas emissions as the country of Denmark annually, according to a new peer-reviewed study released on Monday.
• The report by Harvard University researchers published in the journal Nature Sustainability found that the country's largest data centers emitted 25.7 million tonnes of carbon dioxide between May 2024 and April 2025.
• That amount was three times higher than in 2018, the last time a peer-reviewed measurement of greenhouse gas emissions from data centers took place.
• The report comes amid heavy backlash against hyperscale data centers in the United States. In the Nov. 3 US midterm elections, data center critics who ran on policies such as moratoria on construction or strengthening regulations were among the biggest winners of the Democrats' landslide victories.

• A lead author of the report said the aim of the report is to bring transparency and data to the debate over data centers and AI. "We are highlighting importance of transparency," said Gianluca Guidi, a Harvard researcher on AI and public health. "We tried and managed to bjuild a methodology that is scientifically accepted to build public trust."
• Hyperscale data centers' electricity consumption and associated CO2 emissions vary widely by region, with Virginia, Oregon, Ohio, and Iowa alone making up over half of the electricity use studied, according to the report. Most of the data centers were powered by gas.

items.title: 米ロ、自律型兵器の規制強化反対　既存国際法で対応可能と主張
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Olivia Le Poidevin

［ジュネーブ　１６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Olivia Le Poidevin

［ジュネーブ　１６日　ロイター］ - 米国とロシアが、ジュネーブで１６日から開かれる国連会議で、自律型兵器に関する法的拘束力のある規制の交渉開始を求める動きに反対する構えであることが、外交関係者や人権団体の話で分かった。

会議では、人工知能（ＡＩ）などを搭載して人間の関与を限定した形で標的を識別して攻撃する自律型致死兵器システム（ＬＡＷＳ）の禁止および規制に関する法的拘束力のある枠組みの交渉を開始するかどうかを決める予定で、米ロは既存の国際法で対応可能と主張している。

国連のグテレス事務総長は、法的拘束力のある枠組みの交渉に向けて合意するよう各国に呼びかけた。特定通常兵器使用禁止制限条約（ＣＣＷ）の締約国１２８カ国の大半は支持。外交関係者２人は、議論は難航しても、週末までに妥協点が見つかるとの見方を示した。

会議議長は、２年間の交渉期間を提案。米国は、拘束力のない指針にとどめた上で５年の期間を提案している。国際人権団体ヒューマン・ライツ・ウオッチのベリティ・コイル氏によると、英国、フランス、ドイツは、法的拘束力があるかどうかを明示しない形での交渉を提案しているという。

また、ロシアは、欧州連合（ＥＵ）や非政府組織（ＮＧＯ）などオブザーバーの発言を認める手続き上の規則に異議を唱え、交渉開始を阻止した。アイルランドやカナダなどはこれに反対した。

ＡＩの進化に伴い、人間の関与なく殺傷が可能なドローン（無人機）やロボット、戦車などの軍用品の開発が加速。倫理的な懸念があるものの、ＡＩを活用した半自律型兵器は、ウクライナやスーダン、中東の紛争で使われている。

items.title: CBDT chief says LTCG, STT proposals under review ahead of Union Budget
items.author: Asit Ranjan Mishra, Monika Yadav
items.summary: In pre-Budget consultations, economists advise against abolishing LTCG tax on equities for foreign investors, while the CBDT examines proposals to rationalise LTCG and STT ...
items.body: Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) Chairman Ravi Agrawal on Monday said the government was examining industry proposals to rationalise long-term capital gains (LTCG) tax and securities transaction tax (STT) ahead of the Union Budget. Any decision would be taken only in the Budget, he clarified. Speaking to reporters after inaugurating the Taxpayers’ Lounge at the India International Trade Fair in the national capital, Agrawal said pre-Budget consultations were underway and stakeholder inputs, including their revenue implications, were being analysed. “Stakeholders are putting forward their views, Budget meetings are going on, and pre-Budget consultations are underway. We will consider the suggestions, and I’m sure you will get to know on February 1. Ultimately, an analysis is being done. Whatever issues have been flagged or points raised by stakeholders are being examined,” Agrawal said. Agrawal also expressed confidence that the government would meet its direct tax revenue target of ₹26.97 trillion for the current financial year (2026-27) despite higher refunds. He said net collection growth was currently about 12 per cent, while refunds were roughly 25 per cent higher than a year ago. “On a gross basis, the collections are quite good. I believe that since we have given substantial refunds till now, going forward, the collections will be better,” he said. Official data showed net direct tax collections stood at ₹14.42 trillion as of November 10, up nearly 12 per cent year-on-year and accounting for about 53.5 per cent of the Budget Estimate. Separately, at a pre-Budget consultation, economists urged the finance minister not to abolish LTCG tax on equities for foreign investors. “Generally, economists were not in favour of an LTCG exemption for foreign portfolio investors (FPIs). While one economist supported the abolition of LTCG, six-seven economists opposed the idea. Those opposing it maintained that FPIs were not fleeing India because of LTCG but because of the lack of an artificial intelligence investment opportunity in India. If LTCG were the reason, they would not be returning, as is evident from the turnaround in the stock market. In the medium term, they are unlikely to find a market as stable as India,” an economist who attended the meeting said. Another economist who attended the meeting said one view raised was whether India could tax capital gains on the basis of dollar valuations, given that foreign investors had made gains in the stock market but lost some of those gains because of rupee depreciation. “Some people also believe that the global norm is to tax investors on the basis of residence. Our tax policy should not be driven by knee-jerk reactions to stock market cycles. There should be stability. The hard-fought reforms should not be undone,” the second economist said. The first economist said more than 20 economists and officials had attended the meeting. “It was very well organised. The process was rigorous and methodical. We have all given our written submissions,” the economist added. The short- and medium-term economic outlook was among the other issues discussed, the second economist said. “The path of fiscal consolidation, the necessity of fiscal discipline, the importance of capital expenditure, the importance of energising private sector investment, the necessity of increasing the savings rate in the economy, and further strengthening the health of micro, small and medium enterprises were among the other issues highlighted at the meeting,” the economist said. Currently, LTCG on specified listed equity securities is taxed at 12.5 per cent on gains exceeding ₹1.25 lakh in a financial year, while short-term capital gains on such securities are taxed at 20 per cent, subject to applicable conditions. In October, Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman said she was keen to hear stakeholders’ views on LTCG and STT. Speaking at the Bloomberg New Economy Forum on October 13, she described the debate over these levies and the tax treatment of different asset classes as healthy. She said both domestic and foreign investors had raised the issue but refrained from indicating whether the government would consider any changes, citing preparations for the upcoming Union Budget.

Nov 16 : Former England batter and current national selector Lydia Greenway is also taking on the role of the country's head of women's game strategy, the England and Wales Cricket Board (ECB) said on Monday.
• Greenway's new role will involve working with the ECB leadership to lead their efforts for the long-term development of the women's game, the ECB said in a statement
• The 41-year-old, who played 225 matches for England across all formats, was appointed national selector last year after serving in various coaching roles in the women's teams at Kent, Sydney Sixers and Mumbai Indians
• "It is vital that we continue to push ourselves to keep improving and ensuring that we have the best possible environments for all our women to develop as cricketers," Greenway said

Nov 16 : South Africa have recalled experienced lock Eben Etzebeth for their crunch Nations Championship test against Ireland in Dublin on Saturday, one of five changes to the starting XV that lost to France in Paris.
• Etzebeth is set to extend his Springbok record to 148 caps by partnering Ruan Nortje in the second row, with Cameron Hanekom coming in at number eight as Jasper Wiese faces a possible suspension after his red card against the French
• Props Ox Nche and Wilco Louw plus hooker Malcolm Marx, who were originally selected as the front row last weekend before being replaced just before kick-off in a tactical switch, have been named in the starting XV again
• The backline remains the same with Sacha Feinberg-Mngomezulu at flyhalf and Morne van den Berg the preferred scrumhalf

FAST

LONDON: British actor Robert Pattinson will be the next James Bond, Amazon MGM Studios announced on Monday (Nov 16), taking one of cinema's most coveted roles.
The Bond franchise - about a British secret agent known for his charm, his tailored tuxedos and a fondness for martinis "shaken, not stirred" - is among the longest-running and highest-grossing in Hollywood history.
The franchise made its debut in 1962 and the movies have brought in more than US$7 billion in global ticket sales since Sean Connery brought Agent 007 to the big screen in Dr. No.
More than two dozen Bond films have been released. The upcoming movie will be the first Bond adventure under Amazon MGM Studios, which took creative control of the film franchise under a new joint venture with longtime rights holders Michael Wilson and Barbara Broccoli in 2025.

Denis Villeneuve, an Oscar nominee known for movies such as the "Dune" trilogy and "Arrival," is set to direct the new film, with a script written by Briton Steven Knight.
Pattinson , who has already had a busy 2026 with films The Odyssey, The Drama and Primetime and who will also feature in Villeneuve's Dune: Part Three, to be released next month, succeeds Daniel Craig, who bowed out of the Bond role after the 2021 movie No Time to Die.
"HONOUR OF A LIFETIME" "James Bond is one of the most legendary characters in cinema, and to be entrusted with 007 is the honour of a lifetime," Pattinson said in a statement.
"I'm deeply grateful to Denis, Amy, David, Tanya, and everyone at Amazon MGM Studios for their belief in me. To say this role is a dream come true is an understatement. I couldn’t be more excited about this partnership and the work ahead with this fantastic team," Pattinson said, referring to producers Amy Pascal and David Heyman and executive producer Tanya Lapointe.
Pattinson, 40, made his big-screen debut in Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire in 2005 and has gone on to star in films such as The Twilight Saga, The Lost City of Z and Tenet.
He is no stranger to following other actors to play famous characters, having taken on the lead role of the famed caped crusader in 2022 film "The Batman".
Pattinson only recently joined a list of reported contenders for the James Bond role that included the likes of Slow Horses actor Jack Lowden and One Night Only star Callum Turner.
Villeneuve said Pattinson has "the timeless soul of 007 and brings a spirit that is completely new".
"I cannot wait to begin," the filmmaker said.

Related:

Dune's Denis Villeneuve to direct next James Bond film: 'I'm a die-hard Bond fan'

Daniel Craig on James Bond: 'Hopefully someone completely reinvents it'

The Bond series is based on novels by Ian Fleming. His first book, Casino Royale, was published in 1953.
Other actors who played Bond include Roger Moore, Timothy Dalton and Pierce Brosnan. George Lazenby played the character in one movie, 1969's On Her Majesty's Secret Service.
The official Instagram account of Britain's royal family welcomed the news, saying, "Welcome to His Majesty's Secret Service, Mr Bond".
Courtenay Valenti, head of film at Amazon MGM Studios, said:
"Few films carry the kind of anticipation that comes with James Bond, and we have strived to honour the passionate fans, the legacy, and the future of this iconic character."
"We are thrilled to officially welcome Robert Pattinson as our 007 and are confident he will bring something truly special to this role. Robert, Denis, Amy, David, and Tanya are embarking on an amazing adventure together."

Source: Reuters/dc/fs

FAST

Nov 16 : French Football Federation (FFF) President Philippe Diallo will run for the FIFA presidency in next March's election with the support of the UEFA member associations represented on the executive committee and the FIFA Council, UEFA said on Monday.
FIFA President Gianni Infantino, who will seek reelection as the head of global soccer's ruling body, has faced widespread opposition since his aborted attempt in July to bring private investors into a new FIFA commercial entity holding rights linked to competitions including the World Cup.
"At a meeting held today and chaired by UEFA President Aleksander Ceferin, the national associations ... invited Philippe Diallo, President of the French Football Federation (FFF), to stand as a candidate in the FIFA presidential election in March 2027 and unanimously pledged their full support," a UEFA statement said.
Diallo has accepted the invitation to stand and his candidacy is due to be formally ratified by the FFF Executive Committee on Tuesday.

"Against the backdrop of serious concerns over the direction of FIFA, the national associations called for renewed unity and trust within the global football community," UEFA said.
"They also called for a FIFA that places the development of the game in every region of the world at the heart of its mission, upholds the highest standards of governance and works in close partnership with its member associations, confederations and football stakeholders.
"They expressed their full confidence in Philippe Diallo to provide the leadership needed to achieve this ambition."
UEFA's executive committee met on Monday to find a candidate ahead of Wednesday's deadline, as they look to oust Infantino, who is seeking a fourth term in the election in Rabat on March 18.
DIALLO AND FRANCE WITHDREW INFANTINO SUPPORT
Diallo has been head of the FFF since 2023. He was initially appointed interim president in January 2023, following the resignation of Noel Le Graet, and was elected five months later until the end of 2024.
The 63-year-old, who was re-elected in December 2024 for a four-year term, joined the FFF in 2021 and became vice-president later that year.
In September, the FFF withdrew its support for Infantino's reelection bid, with Diallo saying that "the trust placed in the FIFA president has been broken", adding that France's decision formed part of a broader movement within UEFA.
"We will need to be ready by then to put forward a candidacy capable of winning the FIFA presidency," Diallo said.
Japan Football Association Honorary President Kozo Tashima this month announced his intention to run for FIFA's top position.
Last month, former Tottenham Hotspur defender Ramon Vega was the first candidate to publicly declare his intention to challenge fellow Swiss Infantino.
Candidates require the backing of five national associations to stand in the election.
INFANTINO CRISIS
Infantino was elected FIFA president in 2016 after a corruption scandal ended Sepp Blatter's reign. In 2023, Infantino stood unopposed and was re-elected by acclamation.
Despite repeated calls for his resignation since his failed FIFA Forward Enterprise (FFE) proposal, the 56-year-old maintains he has overwhelming support from member associations around the world.
UEFA initially threatened to boycott FIFA tournaments, before receiving assurances that plans to sell stakes in the World Cup and other major competitions will not be revived.
FIFA announced Infantino's FFE plan without prior consultation with member associations, and his senior advisor, Carlos Cordeiro, resigned three days later.
Even before the FFE proposal, Infantino had come under fire during the World Cup over the decision to suspend a ban imposed on US forward Folarin Balogun after an intervention by US President Donald Trump.
Trump was awarded the FIFA Peace Prize in December last year during the World Cup finals draw, another Infantino decision which drew criticism and will be reviewed by FIFA’s Football Social Responsibility Committee.
Infantino's relationship with the Trump administration is set to come under further scrutiny once the Democrats take control of the House of Representatives in January.
Infantino's candidacy received a significant boost in October when the head of Asian football publicly endorsed him, while support from several FIFA confederations leaves him well placed among the organisation's 211 member associations.

Source: Reuters

items.title: ロ大統領補佐官、和平協議への欧州参加「合意ない」　米側説明と食い違い
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [モスクワ １６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[モスクワ １６日 ロイター] - ロシアのウシャコフ大統領補佐官（外交担当）は１６日、ウクライナ和平を巡る次回協議への欧州代表の参加にロシアは同意していないと述べた。ロシアは欧州の参加を受け入れる用意があるとした米交渉担当者の発言と矛盾する内容となった。

ロシア、ウクライナ、米国の当局者は先週、アラブ首長国連邦（ＵＡＥ）の首都アブダビで９カ月ぶりとなる協議を行った。その後、トランプ米政権のウィットコフ特使がプーチン大統領とモスクワで会談し、同大統領がウクライナ和平協議の次回会合に欧州の代表が参加することに同意したと説明していた。 

ウシャコフ氏はこうした発言について直接言及しなかったものの、記者団に対し「現在議論されているのは、次回協議を三者形式で開催することだ。この協議は数日前にアブダビで再開され、今後も継続することで合意した。日程はまだ決まっておらず、形式の拡大については一部で取り沙汰されているが、われわれとの間で合意には至っていない」と述べた。

欧州の参加にロシアが同意するには何が必要かとの問いに対し、ウシャコフ氏は「合意に至るまでにやるべきことは山積している」と述べ、「三者会談をもう１回、あるいはそれ以上開催する必要があるかもしれない」との考えを示した。

その上で同氏は、欧州の関与については「欧州側が何を望み、ウクライナ問題の解決の成功に向けてどのような建設的かつ実質的な貢献ができるのかについて、ロシアが明確なシグナルを受け取れるかどうか」にかかっていると語った。

FAST

NEW YORK, Nov 16 : As winners were being determined on Monday for President Donald Trump's third crypto gala dinner, scheduled for November 22 at his golf club outside Washington, the president's meme coin was trading near 92 cents, a bruising tumble from its high in 2025 of more than $74.
At the peak of Trump's popularity, the token’s price surged more than 60 per cent when the first contest was announced in April 2025. Wealthy crypto investors collectively wagered $148 million on what the president promoted as the “most EXCLUSIVE INVITATION in the world.” The holdings needed to win a seat at the dinner ranged from $59,000 to $18.5 million.
Today, interest in the third meme coin dinner contest has collapsed. It invited 185 holders of the token, known as $TRUMP, to register and see who held the largest amounts during the contest scoring period from September 30 to November 16. The leaderboard at closing showed only 130 crypto wallets — holding a combined $8.6 million — a 94 per cent drop from the first dinner.
The top 29 wallets will be awarded a “Special VIP Reception” with “YOUR FAVORITE PRESIDENT,” according to the contest's website, along with VIP seating at the dinner.

This will be the third time Morten Christensen, a crypto entrepreneur from the Netherlands, has qualified for the dinner, but the first where he will be at the VIP reception with the president. He came in at 26th on the leaderboard with about $41,000 in time-weighted Trump token holdings.
“You can be in a room with the president of the United States, arguably one of the most powerful people in the world,” said Christensen. “So why would I not go if it cost me almost nothing to go?”
His 23-year-old sister, Gabrielle Felen, is also coming along. She bought about 2,000 Trump tokens. She was disappointed she did not make the top 120 — now, she will not get the gift bag. 
TRUMP CRYPTO VENTURES DEFLATE TO LOWS
The contest’s muted results come at a time when the Trump family’s other crypto-connected equities and ventures have also deflated to record lows. Together, outside investors in the five main crypto and crypto-linked projects have lost more than $5 billion, according to Reuters estimates. 
Most of those losses came before the midterm elections in which the Democrats dealt a heavy defeat to Trump’s Republican Party, a result that sent prices even lower. 
Because the price of the Trump token has continued to fall sharply during the holding period in the run-up to the dinner, the winners have lost millions of dollars in recent weeks. 
The Trump meme coin project and the Trump Organization did not respond to a request for comment. The White House also did not respond to a request for comment but has repeatedly said there is no conflict of interest because the president’s assets are in a trust run by his children.
TRUMP FAMILY EARNS BILLIONS
While most buyers have been left with losses, the Trump meme coin has so far earned the Trump family at least $635 million, according to the president’s June financial disclosure statement. In total, a Reuters analysis found that the Trumps have earned at least $2.3 billion through April from their four main crypto ventures, including the meme coin. The president's stake in the fifth crypto-linked venture, Trump Media & Technology Group, is worth about $500 million.
  The billions the Trump family has earned while in office have drawn opposition from congressional Democrats, who retook control of both the US Senate and US House of Representatives in the midterm elections. They will now have subpoena power and the ability to launch investigations and conduct hearings about what US Senator Elizabeth Warren, a Massachusetts Democrat who will lead oversight on the Senate Banking Committee, has characterized as “an orgy of corruption.” Warren said last Monday that the Trump family crypto businesses will be a focus of her accountability investigations. 
Crypto wallets are anonymous and known only by strings of letters and numbers. The anonymity is what prompted government ethics officials to raise concern about the first two dinners because they said the meme coin could be a conduit for anonymous foreign individuals looking to purchase access to the president. Blockchain analysis showed that of the 220 wallets that  competed in the first contest, more than half were likely based outside the United States.

Source: Reuters

items.title: トランプ氏、フアン氏のエヌビディアＣＥＯ復帰「異存ない」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ワシントン　１６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ワシントン　１６日　ロイター］ - トランプ米大統領は１６日、半導体大手エヌビディアの最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）を辞任したジェンセン・フアン氏について、ＣＥＯへの復帰に異存はなく、多くの人も同氏の復帰を望んでいるとの認識を示した。

トランプ氏はアジア歴訪に向けてホワイトハウスを出発する際、記者団に対し「フアン氏は大きな教訓を学んだと思う。教訓にもさまざまなものがあるだろうが、彼の復帰に全く異存はない」とし、「フアン氏は戻る可能性がある。復帰を望んでいる人は大勢いる」と述べた。ただ、詳細については語らなかった。

フアン氏を巡っては中国のスパイの疑いのある女性のほか、社内幹部との不倫行為が取り沙汰され、エヌビディアは１２日、フアン氏のＣＥＯ辞任を発表した。

トランプ氏は、自身のフアン氏との関係が米国の国家安全保障上のリスクになったとは考えていないと指摘。「国家安全保障が危険にさらされたことはない。米国はかつてないほど強くなっている。中国はわれわれに駆け引きを仕掛け、われわれも中国と駆け引きをしている」と述べ、この問題についてアジア歴訪中に中国の習近平国家主席と協議する可能性があると語った。

また、ジェンセン・フアン氏との関係が取り沙汰されたアリス・フアン氏が中国のスパイだったかは分からないと指摘。「中国から来る美しい女性はみなスパイだと思われがちだが、彼女が本当にスパイだったかは全く分からない」と述べ、調査する考えを示した。

items.title: ウクライナの原子力事故リスク、今冬増大　安全規制当局が警告
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Gwladys Fouche

[オスロ　１６日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Gwladys Fouche

[オスロ　１６日　ロイター] - ３８カ国を代表する原子力安全規制当局が１６日、ウクライナで今冬、原子力事故が起きるリスクが高まっているとし、ロシアに同国の電力インフラへの攻撃を停止するよう求めた。

ロシアは、５年近くに及ぶ紛争で既に弱体化している発電所や送電線、変電所といったウクライナのエネルギー施設に対し、ドローン（無人機）やミサイルによる攻撃を強めている。

欧州放射線防護主管庁会議（ＨＥＲＣＡ）、西欧原子力規制者会議（ＷＥＮＲＡ）、北欧放射線安全当局首脳会議（ＮＯＲＡ）の３団体は、ロイターが公表前に入手した共同声明で、「われわれは共同で、ロシアのウクライナに対する戦争と、同国のエネルギーインフラへの継続的な攻撃に起因する、原子力安全上のリスクの高まりについて深い懸念を表明する」と指摘。

「われわれは共に、ロシアがウクライナの原子力施設およびその安全な運転に不可欠なエネルギーインフラへの攻撃を直ちに停止することが必要だと考える」と訴えた。

３団体は、欧州連合（ＥＵ）全加盟国および米国、英国、カナダ、日本など、計３８カ国を代表している。

規制当局が最も懸念しているのは、送電網からの安定した電力供給がなければ、ウクライナの原発が核物質を冷却し、メルトダウン（炉心溶融）を回避することがますます困難になるという点だ。

仮にメルトダウンが発生すれば、世界最悪の民間原子力事故とされる１９８６年のチョルノービリ（チェルノブイリ）原発事故の際と同様、放射性物質が大気中に放出される恐れがある。

国際原子力機関（ＩＡＥＡ）は１４日、軍事活動により前週、ウクライナの電力供給が不安定となり、同国の稼働中の一部の号機で出力が低下したと発表した。

ウクライナには原発が４基あり、うち３基が稼働しており、今冬に使用される電力の約８０％を供給している。４基目で欧州最大のザポリージャ原発は、前線に近い地域でロシアの支配下にある。

ＨＥＲＣＡとＮＯＲＡのトップを務めるペール・ストランド氏はロイターとのインタビューで、ロシアの攻撃はここ数週間で破壊力を増していると指摘。例として、より大きな弾頭を搭載し、標的をより正確に狙えるドローンが使用されていることを挙げた。

その上で同氏は、「ロシアのこうした新たな戦術により、原子力事故のリスクがこの冬に最も高まるのは明らかだ」と述べた。

items.title: トランプ氏、金正恩氏と中国で会談の可能性示唆　習氏次第とも
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ワシントン １６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ワシントン １６日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は１６日、今週のアジア歴訪中に北朝鮮の金正恩朝鮮労働党総書記と会談する可能性があるとの認識を示した。実現すれば、大統領の歴訪日程が大きく変更される可能性もある。

トランプ大統領は、フィリピンと中国に向かうためホワイトハウスを出発する前、記者団に対し、中国の習近平国家主席が「１カ月前にここを訪れた。われわれは（ロシアの）プーチン大統領とも会談する。金氏とも会談するかもしれない」と語り、「それは良いことだ。多くのことを成し遂げるチャンスがある」と語った。

さらに、金氏との会談は中国で行われる可能性があり、最終的には習氏次第だと述べた。

習氏とプーチン氏との会談では、ウクライナ情勢や核不拡散、イラン問題、経済、貿易について協議するとの考えを示した。

フアン氏の復帰を求める請願サイト「Stand With
items.body:
[１６日 ロイター] - 米ハイテク企業が集積するシリコンバレーの有力者の間で、半導体大手エヌビディアの最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）を辞任したジェンセン・フアン氏の復帰を求める声が高まっている。

フアン氏の復帰を求める請願サイト「Stand With Jensen」によると、これまでに１７万７０００人超が署名。著名実業家イーロン・マスク氏のほか、人工知能（ＡＩ）関連アプリ開発企業レプリットのアムジャド・マサドＣＥＯ、エピックゲームズのティム・スウィーニーＣＥＯらが名を連ねている。

さらに、米投資会社アトレイデス・マネジメントのギャビン・ベイカー氏とアルティメーター・キャピタルのブラッド・ガーストナー氏は公開書簡を公表し、事実関係が十分に明らかになる前にフアン氏の後任人事を急がないよう、エヌビディア取締役会に求めた。

フアン氏は複数の不倫関係が発覚したことを受け、１２日に辞任した。このうち１件は中国のスパイと疑われる人物との関係で、同社の先端ＡＩ半導体の対中輸出を巡る疑問が浮上した。これを受けて同社は危機に陥り、フアン氏が資金面で支えてきたＡＩ業界にも衝撃が広がった。
