TURIN, Nov 16 : Second seed Carlos Alcaraz powered past American Frances Tiafoe 6-2 6-2 in just over an hour at the ATP Finals on Monday to stretch his winning run to 10 matches.
Tiafoe's baseline game was no match for Alcaraz's power and movement, with the world number three dominant from the start following back-to-back titles in Vienna and the Paris Masters.
Alcaraz has won three titles since returning to the tour at the US Open after a break of nearly five months due to a wrist injury.
The 2025 finalist quick charged into a 4-0 lead as the American world number eight was left looking helpless against Alcaraz' versatile play. In a near flawless first set, the Spaniard won 93 per cent of points on his first serve and a perfect 100 per cent on his second.

Nov 16 : Ineos Racing said on Monday it had settled its dispute with Athena Racing over the monohull AC75 yacht that represented Britain and raced as Britannia at the America's Cup.
• The £180 million ($238 million) AC75 yacht, a 23-metre (75-foot) high-performance foiling monohull, was built by four-times Olympic champion Ben Ainslie's Athena Racing when Ineos and Jim Ratcliffe were the team's title sponsors and primary financial backers
• Britain reached the final series for the first time in 60 years in 2024 by defeating Italy but New Zealand beat Ainslie's boat 7-2 to win the Cup for the third time in a row.
• Manchester United co-owner Ratcliffe's Ineos parted ways with Ainslie's Athena Racing in 2025 and sued Athena in the High Court arguing that the team's yacht and associated assets belonged to Ineos

items.title: フーシ派、イエメン南部沿岸地域を制圧　暫定「首都」アデンに迫る
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [１６日 ロイター] - サウジアラビアが支援するイエメン政府軍が暫定「首都」アデンの防衛
items.body:
[１６日 ロイター] - サウジアラビアが支援するイエメン政府軍が暫定「首都」アデンの防衛 に向けて後退したことを受け、親イラン武装組織フーシ派の戦闘員が同国南部の沿岸地域を制圧した。複数の軍関係筋が１６日に明らかにした。住民からは、フーシ派がさらにアデンへ向けて進軍するとの懸念の声が上がっている。

イエメン暫定政府軍は１５日、紅海の要衝バベルマンデブ海峡から撤退し、暫定政府の首都アデンの防衛に集中すると発表。１０月に開始した大々的なフーシ掃討作戦は６週間で事実上終了したことになる。

イエメンの軍関係者５人は１６日、フーシ派戦闘員がアデンの西約１００キロにある南部沿岸地域のホール・オマイラまで進軍し、同じく沿岸部のカワにある政府軍の戦線から２５キロの地点まで迫っていると述べた。

アデンの住民によると、政府治安部隊は市内に検問所を増設し、本人確認を実施しているという。

今夏、米国とイランの衝突により凍結状態にあった内戦が再燃し、サウジ政府が再びフーシ派との対立に巻き込まれる中、フーシ派はイエメン暫定政府から広範な領土を奪取してきた。

イエメンにおけるフーシ派の進展と、サウジおよび紅海の船舶への攻撃は、米国とイスラエルが２月に始めた中東の広範な紛争におけるイランの立場を強めている。

政治・紛争アナリストのモハメド・アルカディ氏は「彼ら（フーシ派）がますます接近する中、アデンは深刻な脅威にさらされている。これは大きな後退だ。（イエメン）政府は首都サヌアの奪還を目指していたが、今はアデンを防衛している」と述べた。

items.title: トランプ氏、8月末にエヌビディア株最大6200万ドル保有か＝米紙
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [１６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[１６日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領が８月末時点でエヌビディア株を１３００万─６２００万ドル保有していたとみられることが分かった。米紙ワシントン・ポストが１６日、同氏の資産開示報告書を精査した結果を報じた。

タイムラグにより報告書には直近２カ月間の取引は反映されていないとした上で、トランプ氏のエヌビディア保有額は、２０２４年末時点で報告された６１万５０００─１３０万ドルを大幅に上回る水準だとしている。

ロイターはワシントン・ポストの報道を直ちに確認できていない。ホワイトハウスとエヌビディアはロイターのコメント要請に直ちに応じなかった。

エヌビディアとトランプ政権との関係には市場の注目が集まっている。エヌビディア共同創業者のジェンスン・フアン氏は先週、中国人女性実業家アリス・フアン氏との関係を巡るスキャンダルを受け、最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）を辞任した。アリス・フアン氏は、中国政府との情報活動上のつながりが疑われている。

フアン氏はシリコンバレーにおけるトランプ氏の最も近しい盟友の一人であり、両者の関係は少なくとも２０２５年にさかのぼる。ロイター記者は昨年１２月、トランプ氏の携帯電話にフアン氏の名前が表示されるのを目にした。

トランプ氏は、米国がエヌビディアに対し、同社が手がける２番目に高性能なＡＩチップであるＨ２００プロセッサーの中国への輸出を認め、その販売に２５％の手数料を課すと述べていた。

items.title: 米、中国の先端ＡＩ半導体アクセスを一段と制限　トランプ氏訪中前に
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Karen Freifeld

［ワシントン　１６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Karen Freifeld

［ワシントン　１６日　ロイター］ - トランプ米政権は１６日、中国企業によるＡＩ（人工知能）モデルの学習に使用する先端ＡＩ半導体へのアクセスにつながっている可能性のある海外のデータセンター向け半導体輸出について、新たな規制を導入した。トランプ大統領のアジア歴訪を控えたタイミングでの発表となった。トランプ氏は１９日、ＡＰＥＣ（アジア太平洋経済協力会議）首脳会議の際に習氏と会談する予定。トランプ氏はこうした会談を前に、中国に対するハイテク関連の措置を打ち出すことが多い。

商務省は声明で「この規則は、第三国のデータセンターを利用した遠隔コンピューティングの仕組みを通じて、米国の機微な技術へのアクセスに関する既存の制限が回避されることを防ぐためのものだ」と説明した。

海外データセンター向けの半導体輸出に対する新たな制限は、こうしたデータセンターを利用して先端ＡＩ半導体にアクセスし、ＡＩモデルを学習させている中国企業に打撃となる。新規則は、商務省が米国の最先端技術への中国のアクセス取り締まりを強化する姿勢を浮き彫りにしている。同省を巡っては、エヌビディアの先端ＡＩ半導体の中国への不正輸出を黙認していたとの報道が出ていた。

商務省はまた、不正な転用を抑制するために、シンガポール、タイ、マレーシア、インドネシア、ブラジルの企業に対し、最先端半導体を輸入する際に米国の輸出許可を取得することを義務付けた。半導体が違法に転用されるのを抑えることが狙い。

items.title: Rupee flies high in Asia on easing crude oil prices, foreign flows
items.author: Anjali Kumari
items.summary: The rupee gained 32 paise to close at 93.93 per dollar on Monday, outperforming Asian peers as foreign portfolio inflows into equities strengthened and crude oil prices eased ...
items.body: The rupee emerged as the best-performing Asian currency on Monday, gaining 0.34 per cent against the US dollar, supported by a sharp reversal in foreign portfolio inflows into domestic equities and easing crude oil prices. The domestic currency settled at 93.93 per dollar, compared with Friday’s close of 94.25, gaining 32 paise. It outperformed its Asian peers, with the South Korean won appreciating 0.16 per cent, the Japanese yen 0.14 per cent, and the Chinese yuan 0.08 per cent. Most other regional currencies weakened against the dollar. The rupee opened largely unchanged but strengthened during the session on dollar sales by foreign banks, likely linked to custodial flows, and private banks, possibly on behalf of corporate clients, dealers said. Foreign portfolio investors (FPIs) have bought $8.5 billion worth of domestic equities so far in November, as of November 12, putting them on course for their highest monthly inflows in six years. They bought another $611 million worth of shares on Friday. The return of foreign equity inflows marks a sharp reversal from the sustained selling seen in recent months. Inflows into the debt segment have also remained positive, albeit at a more modest pace.  The rupee has also drawn support from lower crude oil prices and the continuing impact of the Reserve Bank of India’s foreign exchange measures, market participants said. “The rupee was supported by inflows into equities. In the near term, the rupee could move towards 94.90–95.2 per dollar. The broader appreciation outlook remains intact, with 93.5 and subsequently 93 continuing to be the key downside levels for the rupee,” a market participant said. Axis Bank, in a report, said: “With oil prices now easing, and FPI flows returning strongly in early November, near-term pressure on the currency has further eased.” The rupee’s one-month realised volatility has also declined to around 4 per cent from 6 per cent two weeks ago, indicating an easing in near-term currency fluctuations. However, external pressures, including uncertainty over the US Federal Reserve’s interest rate trajectory and volatility in crude oil prices amid geopolitical tensions in West Asia, continue to pose risks to the domestic currency. Meanwhile, the yield on the 10-year benchmark government security rose 1 basis point (bps) to 7.32 per cent on Monday, compared with 7.31 per cent on Friday. The yield has risen 73 bps so far in the current financial year (2026-27), indicating continued pressure on the bond market even as the rupee strengthened.

FAST

Nov 16 : A petition calling for Jensen Huang to be reinstated as Nvidia CEO has drawn more than 178,000 signatures, including names of prominent Silicon Valley figures, four days after he resigned following revelations of extramarital affairs, including one involving a suspected Chinese spy.
The "Stand With Jensen" campaign listed Elon Musk, CEO of SpaceX and Tesla, Replit CEO Amjad Masad and Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney among its signatories.
Nvidia shares pared early losses but remained more than 1 per cent lower after US President Donald Trump said he would not mind seeing Huang return as CEO.
"I think he learned a big lesson," Trump said.

The website showed more than 8,400 signatories identified themselves as current Nvidia employees and nearly 90,000 as shareholders. It cautioned that professional affiliations were self-reported and had not been independently verified.
"We are current and former NVIDIA employees, partners, shareholders, and supporters. We write with gratitude for Jensen Huang and with a clear demand to the Board: bring Jensen back while an independent investigation establishes the facts," an open letter on the website said.
The campaign comes as some prominent investors also urge Nvidia's board not to rush to replace Huang. Atreides Management's Gavin Baker and Altimeter Capital Management CEO Brad Gerstner said in an open letter that the board should wait until all the facts were known.
Huang stepped down on Thursday after reports of alleged affairs with employees, including one who reported directly to him, plunging the AI chip heavyweight into crisis and sending shockwaves through an industry he helped bankroll.
Corporate boards have previously removed chief executives over relationships with employees. McDonald's fired Steve Easterbrook in 2019 over a consensual relationship with an employee that violated company policy, while Intel CEO Brian Krzanich resigned in 2018 after a similar policy breach.
But the episode also highlights the challenges boards can face when ousting high-profile executives who retain strong employee and investor backing. OpenAI reinstated Sam Altman as CEO in November 2023, just days after his removal triggered an employee revolt and opposition from investors.
The turmoil at Nvidia comes as the company is taking on growing strategic importance in Washington.
Trump's reported trades this year suggest he held between $13 million and $62 million in Nvidia stock as of the end of August, the Washington Post reported on Monday, citing a review of his financial disclosures.
The Trump administration also plans to designate Nvidia and more than two dozen other AI companies as "national champions," the Wall Street Journal reported on Sunday.
US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has called for Nvidia to appoint an outsider as its next CEO, saying the company needs a "dramatic shake-up" following Huang's departure.
Nvidia is due to report third-quarter earnings after the market closes on Tuesday.

Source: Reuters

items.title: Bitcoin slides to $62,000 as analysts eye $60,000 as the line in the sand
items.summary: Bitcoin fell to roughly $62,000 on November 15, 2026, its weakest level since July. That leaves the world's largest crypto asset sitting about 50% below its all-time high of approximately $126,000, ...
items.body:
News
/ Crypto Briefing
/ Bitcoin slides to $62,000 as analysts eye $60,000 as the line in the sand

Bitcoin slides to $62,000 as analysts eye $60,000 as the line in the sand 2 min read

BTCUSD
Bitcoin fell to roughly $62,000 on November 15, 2026, its weakest level since July. That leaves the world's largest crypto asset sitting about 50% below its all-time high of approximately $126,000, set in October 2025.
According to Forbes, analysts are warning that a break below $60,000 could open the door to a slide under $40,000. That is a conditional forecast, not a done deal.
The latest leg down came fast. Bitcoin had peaked at $87,364 on September 21, 2026, according to the research data. Forbes described that September high as nearly $90,000.
Either way, the round trip from there to $62,000 works out to a decline of about 29%. Forbes put it at almost 30%.
Leverage made it worse. Around $2 billion in positions were liquidated within a single 24-hour window after the drop. Most of those were long positions.
Institutional money was also heading for the exits. US spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds recorded net outflows of more than $1.9 billion in the week leading up to November 13, 2026.
The damage shows up clearly in market capitalization. At the lows, Bitcoin's total value sat at approximately $1.3 trillion, down from peaks above $2.5 trillion. That drop also pushed Bitcoin out of the top tier of global asset rankings.
Crypto didn't fall in a vacuum. The selloff lined up with US Treasury yields climbing above 5%, a stronger dollar, and continued weakness in AI-related stocks.
Then there's Elon Musk. His earlier warnings about a potential US fiscal crisis, tied to national debt surpassing $40 trillion, resurfaced in market chatter around the selloff. Forbes framed it as Musk's "global bankruptcy" scenario suddenly feeling less hypothetical.
There's an irony here worth noting. Bitcoin's long-running pitch is that it serves as a hedge against exactly this kind of government debt spiral. Yet when debt fears flared, Bitcoin traded like a tech stock with a hangover rather than a lifeboat.
The low near $62,000 is the weakest print since July 2026. The October 2025 peak was built partly on spot ETF demand and the idea that Wall Street had finally embraced the asset. The current slide shows the flip side: the same plumbing that brought money in can move it out just as efficiently.
The immediate focus is the $60,000 level. If price breaks through, the analysts cited by Forbes see a path toward the sub-$40,000 range.
ETF flows are another key signal. A week of outflows above $1.9 billion reflects institutional caution.
Bitcoin is behaving like a risk asset tied to interest rates and tech sentiment, not like a standalone hedge. The next few weeks of Treasury yields, ETF flows, and price action around that key level will likely decide which story wins.

Why India’s go-to Russian oil imports are set to fall & Brazilian supplies may quadruple in November

The November figures are based on trends and estimates up to 15 November and may change when full-month import data becomes available.

Udit Bubna

New Delhi: India’s Russian crude imports are projected to fall by nearly 400,000 barrels per day (b/d) in November, while purchases from Brazil are expected to almost quadruple, pointing to a shift in the country’s oil sourcing as changing prices make alternative supplies more attractive to refiners.

India’s overall crude imports are estimated to average around2 5.2 million b/d in November, compared with a record 5.7 million b/d in October, according to preliminary Kpler data shared by Natalia Katona, a commodity analyst with OilPrice.com based in Abu Dhabi. Higher purchases from Saudi Arabia and Iraq have also helped offset the decline in Russian supplies.

However, the moderation in imports does not necessarily indicate weaker refinery demand. Katona said October’s unusually high purchases should be taken into account when assessing the November figures, rather than viewing the moderation as an indication of a slowdown in refining activity.

Show Full Article

The more significant development is the changing composition of India’s crude imports.

Russian deliveries are projected at around 1.7 million b/d in November, down from approximately 2.07 million b/d in October. This follows a sharp increase observed earlier in the year, when Russian supplies accounted for more than half of India’s crude imports in July, according to Kpler data.

The November figures are based on trends and estimates up to 15 November and may change when full-month import data becomes available.

The latest decline is primarily linked to pricing rather than any fundamental shift in India’s preference for Russian oil.

Russian Urals crude is generally priced against Dated Brent, a benchmark reflecting the price of physical crude oil cargoes, with sellers offering an additional premium or discount depending on market conditions.

During October, Dated Brent surged to $120-135 per barrel, around $18-20 above Dubai and ICE Brent, amid physical crude shortages in Northern Europe. ICE Brent is an international crude oil benchmark based on futures contracts traded on the Intercontinental Exchange and is widely used to price oil purchases globally.

However, Russian sellers were slow to adjust Urals pricing to reflect these changes, Katona said. Urals was offered at a premium of around $7 per barrel to Dated Brent at the beginning of October, with prices remaining at or above the benchmark until early November. This made Russian crude more expensive than competing grades for Indian refiners.

Russian discounts return, Gulf and Brazilian supplies gain
The pricing situation has since changed. Russian producers have begun offering Urals at a discount of around $3-4 per barrel to Dated Brent in November, which itself has fallen to around $96 per barrel. Its premium over Dubai has also narrowed to approximately $4 per barrel.

This has made Russian crude more attractive to Indian refiners, and Katona expects them to increase their orders for December deliveries.

“Russian producers have clearly adjusted to regional pricing and are once again making Urals economically attractive, although the effect will show up in deliveries over the coming months,” she said.

Other factors could also support Russian exports to India. Fewer Russian refineries were offline in October as Ukrainian attacks eased, allowing more crude to be processed domestically.

However, the seasonal closure of the Northern Sea Route is expected to reduce the volume of Russian crude moving to China through that route, potentially freeing up more supplies for India. Katona expects this to support higher Urals deliveries to India in December and January.

Meanwhile, imports from the Middle East Gulf are increasing, particularly from Saudi Arabia and Iraq.

Saudi Arabia has stepped up exports from its Gulf terminals as its Red Sea export terminal at Yanbu faces repeated Houthi attacks. This has made India an attractive destination for Saudi sellers because of its proximity to Gulf export terminals, reducing voyage times and freight costs, Katona said.

The same economics apply to Iraqi crude. Katona expects the price difference between Gulf crude grades and Dubai to narrow for December deliveries as shipping traffic through the Strait of Hormuz improves and regional oil producers restore output.

Meanwhile, Brazil has emerged as another important supplier, with India’s imports of Brazilian crude projected to reach around 400,000 b/d in November, almost four times October’s level of around 100,000 b/d. Meanwhile, Venezuelan crude supplies to India are estimated to remain steady at around 300,000 b/d during the month.

The increase in Brazilian supplies comes as the country’s oil production reaches record levels following the ramp-up of new projects. At the same time, Chinese buyers have reduced their purchases of Brazilian crude, creating an opportunity for Indian refiners to secure cargoes.

Another advantage is that Brazilian and Venezuelan oil shipments do not have to pass through conflict-hit regions or vulnerable shipping routes, making them relatively more secure supply options for Indian refiners.

(Edited by Anupama Yadav)

Senator accuses US Commerce Department of failing to stem flow of AI chips to China

This follows remarks by United States Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent that the Treasury, the Pentagon, the State Department and the US Trade Representative's Office had been in favour of putting Megaspeed, the company at the heart of the Nvidia scandal, on a trade blacklist for months.

FAST

WASHINGTON: The Senate Commerce Committee's top Democrat has accused the Commerce Department of not doing enough to prevent China from obtaining advanced AI chips, saying Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick's failure to take action undermined national security.
"America cannot maintain its leadership in AI if the agency responsible for protecting that advantage fails to enforce its own controls," Senator Maria Cantwell said in a Nov 15 letter to Lutnick seen by Reuters.
The letter follows remarks by United States Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent that the Treasury, the Pentagon, the State Department and the US Trade Representative's Office had been in favour of putting Megaspeed, the Singapore company at the heart of the Nvidia scandal, on a trade blacklist for months.
However, the Commerce Department, which is in charge of the list, had not been in favor, Bessent said on Friday.

"Despite these warnings, the Department of Commerce delayed action on repeated national security warnings, putting America's technological advantage in AI at risk," Cantwell said.
Lutnick's failure to use his authority has "undermined America's national security," she also wrote.
A spokesperson for Lutnick declined to comment on the letter.
Megaspeed has been in the spotlight following reports that former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had an affair with former Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, whom US authorities suspect of being a Chinese spy.
In October 2025, the New York Times reported that US authorities were investigating whether Megaspeed helped Chinese customers obtain Nvidia computer chips subject to Washington's export controls. China has denied the allegation and Megaspeed has not been found to have violated the rules.
Megaspeed said on Sunday that Alice Huang left the company in August 2025 and that it conducts a "legitimate and lawful business."
Cantwell also said that the Commerce Department had suspended a probe into Megaspeed, and that financial conflicts raise serious questions about whether it was putting business interests ahead of national security.
She noted that the Trump administration had imposed a 25 per cent fee on certain Nvidia chips sold to China, arguing that this created "a perverse financial incentive to approve exports of sensitive American technology."
Cantwell is the latest of a slew of US lawmakers who have called for tougher restrictions on China's access to advanced AI chips in the wake of the scandal.
House Speaker Mike Johnson said on Thursday that the growing consensus in Congress favors new restrictions. Senator Elizabeth Warren, a Democrat from Massachusetts, and Senator Jim Banks, an Indiana Republican, argue export-control decisions with major national security implications should face greater congressional oversight.

Source: Reuters/ao

FAST

BENGALURU/LONDON, Nov 16 : The sudden departure of Nvidia's influential CEO, Jensen Huang, has shifted attention ahead of the chip giant's quarterly earnings from concerns over narrowing margins and use of cash to more critical questions about its influence across the AI ecosystem.
Huang stepped down last Thursday after revelations of extramarital affairs, including one involving a suspected Chinese spy, plunging the chipmaker into crisis and sending shockwaves across an AI industry he helped bankroll.
Nvidia's finance chief, Colette Kress, is currently interim CEO and its board has said it is in the process of selecting a search firm for the CEO role.
The company is due to report third-quarter earnings after the market closes on Tuesday.

Until this leadership crisis, investors had been obsessing over the sharp fall in the company's market valuation, questioning whether the debt-fuelled AI spending would continue into 2027 and whether its high margins were sustainable.
Now they hope Kress can assuage worries over whether Nvidia can keep up its cutting-edge chip dominance while supporting cloud providers, suppliers and labs with cash and guarantees in the absence of its rock-star CEO. Wall Street analysts are also certain to quiz her on the possibility Huang returns to the helm.
"The earnings itself should be typical, but any comfort we can get on the rest of the business and the management changes is probably the most important piece," said Brian Colello, technology equity analyst at Morningstar Research Services.
"We'll want any early insights on what Nvidia will do in the interim, what they're seeing with customers, what they're seeing with partnerships, finance, government, a lot of questions there. I don't know if we'll get many answers, but we'll want to at least hear the company's statements on those sort of things."
The $4 trillion company, which was until recently the world's most valuable, has blown analysts' expectations consistently.
In the second quarter that ended in July, its revenue more than doubled from a year earlier, gross margins were at 75 per cent and it returned $26 billion to shareholders via buybacks and dividends. It then said it expects revenue of $108 billion, plus or minus 2 per cent, in the third quarter, 70 per cent growth next year and a dip in gross margins because of rising memory costs.
Adjusted profit in the October quarter is expected to be $2.47 per share, compared with $1.30 in the same quarter last year.
Yet its share price has fallen by a third from an October peak, and the price-to-earnings ratio is down to 11 from as high as 40 eight months ago.
"The multiple has been under pressure even prior to Huang's departure. The market is evidently sceptical of those earnings' growth expectations," said Rory Dowie, London-based equity portfolio manager at asset manager Marlborough, who exited his Nvidia positions last week.
"We do believe that Huang's departure puts those earnings more at risk. We prefer to be positioned in the companies looking to take share out of the Nvidia pie. Huang departing perhaps pushes the door a bit more open for the likes of AMD or Broadcom," he said.
BY THE NUMBERS
Dan Morgan, a portfolio manager at Synovus Trust, expects total revenues in the third quarter to be $2 billion to $3 billion above the consensus estimate of $109.08 billion, which would be more than 90 per cent growth over last year.
But he too thinks the biggest question for investors this week is "what does Nvidia need to do to shake off the abundance of uncertainties circling the company to allow the stock break out of the current trading range?"
Among key numbers investors are watching is the contribution of Nvidia's new Vera Rubin data center platform and whether it meets projections that the Rubin GPUs will make up a fifth of the third-quarter revenue.
Another issue investors will seek answers on is Nvidia's willingness to sustain the enormous financing deals that interim CEO Kress is believed to have pushed back against. The deals, including investments in OpenAI and AI infrastructure companies such as Lambda, fed into what some Wall Street critics have deemed a risky, circular AI economy.
By some estimates, Nvidia has more than half a trillion dollars of commitments in the form of various supply and capacity backstops for chip purchases, data center leases and equity investments, which nonetheless are a fraction of firm's market capitalisation.
Max Anderl, a hedge fund manager with SilverSea Asset Management, said besides investor unease over the effective use of cash, it is notable that nearly a third of Nvidia's enormous profits are non-operating profits, implying they come from the mark-to market values of the equity investments.
"If the whole AI story changes, then you have to write down these investments and the whole train would reverse. And that's why I think the stock’s multiple has contracted, long before the exit of its CEO, despite continuous good results."

Source: Reuters

ISLAMABAD, Nov 16 : Pakistan's consumer price inflation is expected to gradually ease towards medium-term target range of 5 per cent to 7 per cent during financial year 2027, the country's central bank said on Monday.
Real GDP growth will remain in the range of 3.5 per cent to 4.5 per cent, the bank said in a yearly report, which added the country's current account deficit was likely to be in range of 0 to 1 per cent of GDP in the financial year.
It projected fiscal deficit to range between 3.0 – 4.0 per cent of the GDP.

Source: Reuters

items.title: ウクライナ、ロシアに最大規模のドローン攻撃　橋や製油所標的
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Andrew Osborn　Gleb Stolyarov

[モスクワ １６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Andrew Osborn　Gleb Stolyarov

[モスクワ １６日 ロイター] - ロシア国防省が１６日に公表したデータによると、ウクライナは２０２２年に全面戦争が始まって以降、最大規模となる夜間の無人機（ドローン）攻撃を仕掛けた。戦略上重要な橋や製油所が標的となった。

ロシア側は防空部隊が１６地域でドローン１３３６機を撃墜したと発表した。これまでの最多は１０月２９日の１２５４機だった。国防省によると、ドローンの一部はクリミア半島、アゾフ海、黒海の上空で撃墜された。

ウクライナのドローン攻撃の規模と頻度は増している。ロシアもドローンとミサイルによる攻撃を強めており、双方がエネルギー施設や重要インフラを標的にする消耗戦が激化している。

先週、米国の仲介で９カ月ぶりとなる和平協議がアブダビで開かれたほか、米特使２人がロシアのプーチン大統領、ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領とそれぞれ会談するなど、和平を巡る協議は行われているものの、攻撃は続いている。

モスクワのソビャニン市長によると、首都周辺地域には、１５日夕方以降に約６００機のウクライナのドローンが発射され、このうち１９１機が撃墜された。

ロシアが支援するクリミアのアクショーノフ知事は、クリミア半島とロシア南部クラスノダール地方を結ぶ道路・鉄道橋が攻撃を受けたと明らかにした。この橋は戦略上重要な役割を担っており、プーチン氏の業績を象徴するインフラ事業の一つ。

ロシア大統領府は被害は軽微だとした。運輸省は声明で、補修作業のため道路の通行が一時停止されたが、鉄道は通常通り運行していると説明した。

各種石油施設があるロストフ州のスリュサリ知事は、ウクライナの攻撃後、アゾフの産業施設４カ所で火災が発生したと明らかにした。緊急対応当局が現場で対応に当たっているという。

また当局によると、クラスノダール地方イルスキーの産業施設でも火災が発生し、落下したドローンの破片で子どもを含む６人が負傷した。施設名は明らかにしていない。イルスキーには製油所がある。

ウクライナは１０月末以降、ロシアの製油所への攻撃を大幅に強化している。ゼレンスキー氏は１５日夜、これらの攻撃でロシアの石油精製能力の半分以上が停止したと述べた。ロイターはこの主張を直ちに独自確認できなかった。

ウクライナとロシアは先週の協議で大規模な捕虜交換に合意したが、領土問題を含む他の重要課題では大きな進展はなかった。ロシアはウクライナ領土の約５分の１を支配しており、前線は数カ月にわたりこう着している。

items.title: 中国百度7─9月期、売上高が予想と一致　ＡＩクラウド好調
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [１６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[１６日 ロイター] - 中国の百度（バイドゥ）が１６日発表した７─９月期の売上高は３０８億１０００万元（４６億２０００万ドル）と、市場予想にほぼ一致した。人工知能（ＡＩ）クラウド・コンピューティング・サービスの需要が好調だった一方、中核の広告部門は低迷した。

ＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリスト１５人の予想平均は３０８億６０００万元だった。

全体のコストが減少したことが寄与し、米国預託株式１株当たりの調整後利益は６．７８元と、予想の６．３６元を上回った。

クラウドコンピューティング事業への多額の投資が寄与し、ＡＩ関連事業の売上高は３７％増の１３２億元（１９億８０００万ドル）となった。ＡＩクラウドインフラの売上高は９４％増の８２億元に急増した。

ただ、投資家の間では、百度のＡＩモデル「アーニー」に大幅な改良がないため、ＡＩ分野でアリババやディープシーク、ムーンショットなどに後れを取っているとの懸念がある。

それでもＡＩ関連サービスは、主力のオンライン広告事業の需要減速を補った。オンライン・マーケティング・サービス売上高は２２％減の１１９億元だった。

items.title: 対中ＡＩ半導体規制、商務省の取り組み不十分と米議員が批判
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
David Shepardson

[ワシントン １６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
David Shepardson

[ワシントン １６日 ロイター] - 米上院商務委員会の民主党トップ、マリア・キャントウェル議員は、中国による先端人工知能（ＡＩ）半導体の入手を阻止するための商務省の取り組みが不十分だと批判した。ラトニック商務長官が措置を講じなかったことで、国家安全保障が損なわれたと主張した。

ラトニック氏に宛てた１５日付の書簡で「ＡＩ分野での優位を守る責任を負う機関が自らの規制を執行しなければ、米国は主導的な地位を維持できない」と述べた。ロイターが書簡を確認した。

ベセント財務長官はこれまでに、エヌビディアを巡るスキャンダルの渦中にあるシンガポール企業メガスピードを貿易上のブラックリストに加えることについて、財務省、国防総省、国務省、米通商代表部が数カ月前から支持していたと発言していた。しかしリストを所管する商務省が賛成していなかったという。

キャントウェル氏は「国家安全保障上の警告が繰り返されたにもかかわらず、商務省は対応を先送りし、ＡＩ分野での米国の技術的優位を危険にさらした」と指摘した。ラトニック氏が権限を行使しなかったことで「米国の国家安全保障が損なわれた」と記した。

米紙ニューヨーク・タイムズは２０２５年１０月、米国の輸出規制の対象となっているエヌビディア製半導体を中国の顧客が入手するのをメガスピードが支援した疑いについて、米当局が調査していると報じた。

キャントウェル氏は商務省がメガスピードへの調査を停止したとし、金銭面での利益相反により、同省が国家安全保障よりもビジネス上の利益を優先していたのではないかという重大な疑問が生じていると述べた。

トランプ政権が中国向けに販売されるエヌビディア製半導体の一部に２５％の手数料を課したことに触れ、これが「米国の機微な技術の輸出を承認するよう促す、ゆがんだ金銭的動機」を生んだと主張した。

items.title: ユーロ圏の銀行、アウトソーシングは詐欺よりリスク＝ＥＣＢ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
[フランクフルト １６日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）は１６日に公表した「金融安定性レビュー」で、ユーロ圏の銀行にとって、外部プロバイダーの問題は詐欺行為の試みよりも大きな技術的問題の原因となっていると述べた。

• ２０２５年初頭から２６年９月までの間にユーロ圏の銀行で発生した主要なサイバーインシデントのうち、悪意のある行為によるものは比較的少ない割合を占めており、これらのインシデントのほとんどは影響が軽微だったという。

• 対照的に、サイバーインシデントの約５分の１は、銀行が特にＩＴシステムのために利用している第三者プロバイダーに起因するものだった。

items.title: 中国レアアース大手2社の収益力向上、価格高と業界改革が追い風
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Solomon Cefai

[シンガポール １６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Solomon Cefai

[シンガポール １６日 ロイター] - 中国のレアアース（希土類）生産大手２社が収益力を高めている。鉱物価格の上昇と、業界の混乱を抑えようとする中国政府の取り組みが追い風となっている。

中国北方稀土（ＣＮＲＥ）の第３・四半期決算に基づくと、１─９月の純利益は３６億５０００万元（５億４７１９万ドル）と、前年同期の２倍超に増えた。

中国稀土集団資源科技も、１─９月の利益が４億０８００万元と２倍超となった。

両社とも通期利益はアナリスト予想を上回るペースで推移している。

中国が２０２５年４月に導入した輸出規制の対象外である軽レアアースの価格が堅調で、規制対象のレアアースの出荷減少を補った。このため、国内大手に対する規制の影響が抑えられている。

シティのアナリスト、アンナ・ワン氏は「供給側の改革で業界の規律が改善し、価格が下支えされている」と述べた。その結果レアアース価格が上がったことが、中国のレアアース生産会社の好業績の「主な要因」だと分析した。

中国は数十年にわたり、多くの主要産業を悩ませてきた供給過剰を防ぐため、レアアースの生産枠を設け、企業の統合を促してきた。２４年に生産枠の割り当て先を従来の６社からＣＮＲＥと中国稀土集団資源の２社に絞った。ワン氏は集約によって生産量の監督が強化されたと述べた。

FAST

Nov 16 : Papa John's wants AI to have a look at your pizza before you take your first bite.
The chain is offering a free pizza to customers who send in a photo of their delivered order, along with some feedback, as part of an AI-based quality-control campaign to help make sure each of its pizzas is properly cooked and cut.
CEO Todd Penegor told Reuters in an interview that the promotion will help the chain to improve pizza quality across its franchised restaurants — addressing inconsistencies that he said have become the “Achilles’ heel” of the brand.
The aim, Penegor said, is to develop a system that can mirror the chain’s in-store quality-control cameras, which use AI to check that cheese is not burnt, pepperoni slices are cut smoothly and the outer crust is shaped like “a beautiful breadstick.”

But those in-store cameras are only installed in a few hundred locations out of the chain’s 6,000 worldwide, he said. The user-submitted images could allow the company to apply image-based quality control far more widely and cheaply, although they are not yet as accurate as the in-store cameras.
The company has a “huge dashboard with all of the pictures that are coming in,” as well as user-submitted feedback, he said, adding that the promotion generated thousands of photos for the company in the first few days after it began on November 9. It will last until November 20.
Penegor said the technology was relatively cheap to develop in-house and that it built on existing AI technology the company has developed in partnership with Google Cloud.
The company reported a 6.5 per cent decline in quarterly same-store sales on November 5. Penegor said feedback from the promotion will help the chain decide which fixes to prioritize and give franchisees a clear view of where their restaurants may fall short.

Nov 16 : The US National Highway Traffic Safety Administration said on Monday it had opened an engineering analysis into 1,033,632 Honda vehicles in the country over concerns that their engines failed to restart after being shut off by the vehicles' automatic stop-start system.
The agency said it has received 701 complaints about the auto stop-start feature in the 2024-2026 model year Honda Odyssey, Passport, Ridgeline and Pilot, as well as the Acura MDX.
The auto stop-start system is designed to save fuel. It turns off the engine when the vehicle comes to a complete stop and is supposed to restart it when the driver takes their foot off the brake.
However, drivers have complained that their engines did not restart after being shut off by the system.

FAST

PROVIDENCE, RHODE ISLAND, Nov 16 : Until recently, investors embraced artificial intelligence as one of the biggest bets Wall Street had ever made. Now many portfolio managers are treating the sector with greater caution as they try to assess how much AI risk is embedded in their portfolios.
There is a lot at stake. At least $25.3 trillion is invested in the largest global companies with the most direct exposure to AI, according to the MSCI Global Intelligence Index. Beyond that is an impossible-to-quantify additional exposure to companies that may benefit or suffer as AI reshapes industries.
The latest bruising selloff in AI-related stocks, including the slump on Wednesday, prompted by the resignation of Nvidia's CEO, Jensen Huang, has put a new focus on how much AI exposure investors actually have.
For Andy Goldberg, chief investment strategist at Nomura Asset Management, the scale of the problem hit home last month when he saw that wedding retailer David's Bridal  planned to spin off and list its AI wedding-planning business next year.

"Since when was a wedding gown shop a play on AI?" Goldberg said, adding the problem is that exposure to AI exists even in the most unlikely corners of the economy. David's Bridal CEO Kelly Cook said the firm "has been a pioneer in applying AI to retail for several years.”
From trucking companies using AI tools to tackle logistical problems to municipal bonds whose credit ratings may hinge on revenue derived from building new data centers, AI impacts both risk and return, Goldberg said.
"No one fully understands how much exposure they have to AI; it’s really become just one big trade at this point,” said Goldberg. If investors decide to trim even 1 per cent or 2 per cent from their allocations to AI plays, he added, the reaction will be "something that (looks) like a rout."
FORENSIC TASK 
For investors trying to map that exposure, the process is increasingly becoming a forensic exercise.
At PGIM, the investment arm of Prudential Insurance, analysts and portfolio managers overseeing nearly $1 trillion in fixed-income investments began this year putting every bond, loan, and structured security through two AI-focused screens. One evaluates AI's impact on a company's business model and credit profile; the other looks for exposure to events ranging from a slowdown in AI-related capital spending to a market crisis in the most unlikely companies. 
“We know how to assess the direct exposure, like, I have a data center or I have chips” in the portfolio, said Brian Barnhurst, head of global credit research at PGIM. “But how about the indirect things? And that’s critically important to understand."
Barnhurst said the approach helps analysts isolate "what does AI mean for this healthcare business, or this industrial business or this telecom business?” 
OVEREXPOSED? 
The amount invested in AI is huge. 
The Equable Institute, a nonpartisan pension fund think tank, calculated that a basket of 52 publicly traded AI-related companies made up 38.5 per cent of public equity holdings at a group of large pension funds as of June 2026, up from 20.7 per cent at the beginning of 2010. 
Those funds have between 9 per cent and 11 per cent of their assets invested in AI-focused companies, Equable calculated.  The figure excludes debt holdings, venture capital and other private equity investments, meaning it almost certainly understates their broader exposure.
"Understanding true portfolio exposure is becoming more important" at this point in the AI cycle, said Jay Jacobs, US head of equity ETFs at BlackRock. The fact that so many AI core holdings now dominate big indexes creates a degree of concentration that is "making diversification harder to achieve than investors may realize."
Adding to the uncertainty is the near-constant news around major AI players such as Nvidia, the looming IPO of Anthropic and concerns over CoreWeave.
Some managers are responding by becoming pickier. 
The market's willingness to pummel members of the AI trade "can be seen as an early warning indicator that we all need to be more selective in looking at the AI rollout," said Peter Berezin, chief economist at BCA Research, a market, economic and geopolitical analysis firm. "It's very possible that AI will end up making companies a lot more productive but not necessarily more profitable."
Powell Industries, whose power management systems are key components in data centers, illustrates the swings. Its stock, only $8 four years ago, this year traded as high as $328 but has since slumped to $146. 
Powell Industries did not respond to requests for comment.
Berezin said that bottlenecks in data center construction will eventually ease, diminishing windfall gains for Powell and other AI beneficiaries. When that happens is another unknown.
GASOLINE TO THE FIRE
That is a recipe for continued volatility, investors and analysts agree.
"We've seen a sort of laundry list of concerns pile up" since June, when AI valuations peaked, said Shaon Baqui, a technology analyst at Janus Henderson. He said the US midterm election result "almost feels like putting gasoline on top of the fire," with Democratic gains raising concerns about the future of AI growth. The result, he said, is that investors "increasingly will want to separate the wheat from the chaff."
Liz Ann Sonders, chief investment strategist at the Schwab Center for Financial Research, said that even with careful research, "the math behind all of this AI exposure" makes such a concentrated market particularly difficult to navigate. 
But a hard-headed assessment of AI portfolio concentration could uncover opportunities as well as risks, said Rob Arnott, founder of Syzygy Asset Management.
"There's a kind of tunnel vision at work here," he said. While investors are "taking on substantial risk in a segment of the market that is frothier, they are overlooking the chance to invest early in other companies for whom AI will create value that has so far gone unrecognized."

Source: Reuters

FAST

Nov 16 : Enterprise AI firm Fractal Analytics is actively talking to 20 to 25 startups to potentially acquire them, its CEO told Reuters, as it seeks to deepen its vertical-specific capabilities and gain early access to frontier AI models.
Fractal, India's first publicly listed pure-play AI company, helps clients, including Citibank and Nestle, make business decisions using data analytics and AI. It reported profit of 812 million rupees ($8.63 million) and revenue of 9.57 billion rupees for the quarter ended September 30. 
Acquisitions and partnerships are a major vehicle of growth for Fractal, said group CEO Srikanth Velamakanni.
The firm is evaluating startups in healthcare, as well as agentic AI and AI engineering companies, to access good engineering talent and harness relationships that the target startups have with large cloud computing firms and frontier labs, he said.

The company does not have a target, but is open to acquisitions of up to 10 billion rupees, he said, adding that the firm evaluated about 800 targets over the last 12 months.
"There is no lower floor for (acquisitions). Our sweet spot is between $50 million and $100 million (for) what we would spend," said Velamakanni.
Earlier in November, it acquired Geneva-based analytics firm PricingOne via a subsidiary, Asper, for 1.32 million Swiss francs ($1.57 million).
Nearly half of all M&A deals in the last two fiscal years among Indian IT and tech companies involved AI and allied technologies, with most acquisitions being used to find specialised talent and access clients faster, according to research from Indian ratings agency Crisil Ratings.
AI is getting better at doing longer-horizon tasks and solving more complex problems, and the cost of using it is continuously dropping, spurring greater demand for enterprise AI solutions, Velamakanni said.
The upcoming IPO of frontier AI model company Anthropic will be a major tailwind for AI companies, including Fractal, if it succeeds, he said, but warned that there were structural risks with the level of debt that US companies have taken on to build out AI infrastructure.
"The structural risk that the (US) economy has ... is that it's very much driven by AI growth today," he said. "But that doesn't mean that need (for AI) will come down or that companies are not going to spend on AI."
($1 = 94.1200 Indian rupees)
($1 = 0.8384 Swiss francs)

items.body:

BTC price tags 18-week low into Nvidia earnings: Three things to know in Bitcoin this week 3 min read

BTCUSD USDJPY
Bitcoin BTCUSD traded around $64,500 early Monday after a sell-off in thin weekend trading sent it to a four-month low of $61,950.
Key points:
Bitcoin fell below its 200-week simple moving average, now at $68,186.
Nvidia reports third-quarter earnings Tuesday following Jensen Huang’s resignation, with the company forecasting about $108 billion in revenue.
Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh speaks Monday, and minutes of the Fed’s October policy meeting are due Wednesday.
Bitcoin falls below its 200-week moving average
Data from TradingView showed that BTCUSD fell to $61,950 on Bitstamp, a level last seen on July 13. The pair briefly rebounded to $66,000 before easing to around $64,500 during Monday’s Asian trading session.

BTCUSD one-hour chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView
The drop pushed Bitcoin below its 200-week simple moving average (SMA) of $68,186. This cemented concerns about Bitcoin’s rebound to $87,000, which began in August, as flipping the 200-week SMA from resistance to support has been a prerequisite for previous bear-market recoveries.
“Deviating below the 200-week SMA has historically been the key to building out a Bear Market bottom formation,” crypto trader and analyst Rekt Capital said Saturday on X.

BTCUSD one-week chart with 200-week SMA. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView
From Friday to 10 am UTC on Monday, Bitcoin open interest fell by around 9.1% to $20.98 billion, according to onchain analytics platform CryptoQuant.
A CryptoQuant contributing analyst drew comparisons to similar open interest drawdowns in February and June, considering whether Bitcoin was forming a local bottom.
“If the flush is complete, a bottoming zone may be near. If shorts keep piling up, even a modest rally could squeeze them. The $59K-$60K summer low remains the next key test,” the analyst wrote on Sunday.

Bitcoin open interest. Source: CryptoQuant
Bitcoin perpetual futures funding rates briefly turned negative near the weekend low, meaning traders with short positions paid those with long positions.

Bitcoin funding rates. Source: CryptoQuant
Nvidia earnings due Tuesday as allies push for Huang’s return
Nvidia remains in the spotlight this week as the tech giant reports third-quarter results after US markets close Tuesday amid ongoing controversy over former CEO Jensen Huang.
On Tuesday, interim CEO Colette Kress will lead the company’s earnings call. Nvidia previously forecast quarterly revenue of around $108 billion, and analysts expect earnings per share to nearly double year over year.
Huang is reportedly considering a return to Nvidia. He resigned last week after reports that he had an affair with a chip executive whom US authorities suspect of spying for China. Beijing denied the espionage allegation.
The Financial Times reported that a “war room” of tech CEOs and others was lobbying for his reinstatement, while an open letter calling for his return has garnered more than 165,000 signatories, including Tesla and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk.
“A petition is underway to reinstate Jensen and I’m signing it too,” Musk said in an X post on Friday.
The efforts face friction from US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, who said that Nvidia should hire its next CEO from outside the company.
“This makes me think that as the board conducts a search for a new leader that they need to go outside the company, that just [with] what was going on inside the company, they need a dramatic shakeup,” he told Fox News.
Nvidia shares closed Friday at $162.85, down 12.7% for the week. On Thursday, shares fell to $148.80, their lowest since mid-2025, before recovering some of their losses.

Nvidia stock one-week chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView
Nvidia headlines rattled tech stocks and crypto markets last week. Investors will be watching the company’s outlook for signs of how demand for AI chips is holding up.
Fed minutes due as markets price in December rate hike
Fed officials will speak throughout the week as traders look for clues about the December rate decision.
Warsh will deliver opening remarks at the Fed’s Productivity and Jobs Task Force Conference in San Francisco at 9 am PT (5 pm UTC) on Monday. He will also moderate two panels and a fireside chat.
On Wednesday, the Fed will release minutes of its Oct. 27–28 policy meeting. Officials left rates unchanged at 3.75% to 4%, and Warsh cited “resilient” domestic spending in the face of global geopolitical uncertainty.
After the latest economic data, markets fully priced in a quarter-point rate hike from the Fed in December. Last week’s Consumer Price Index (CPI) beat expectations, and while the Producer Price Index (PPI) reading was lower than anticipated, the annual increase was still the largest in four years.
Meanwhile, the 10-year US Treasury yield rose above 5%, and the Japanese yen brought back a familiar headwind for crypto markets as it weakened past the key psychological level of 160 per US dollar on Friday.

USDJPY one-day chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView
Japan’s economy shrank at an annualized rate of 0.1% in the third quarter, according to data released Monday. The contraction complicates the outlook for further rate hikes in Japan, where the policy rate is already at a three-decade high of 1.25%.
“With the yen perched precariously at 160 per dollar, a combination of sluggish domestic growth and sticky price pressures, if they were to materialize, would complicate life for both the Bank of Japan and the Ministry of Finance,” economist Mohamed El-Erian wrote over the weekend.

NEW YORK, Nov 16 : The dollar strengthened on Monday to its highest level against a basket of currencies since April 2025, remaining supported by last week's strong inflation data and hawkish Fed commentary.
The US currency, which slumped after President Donald Trump's "Liberation Day" tariffs were unveiled in April last year on fears of diminished appeal of US assets, has recovered as solid US growth and buoyant equity markets have restored some of that appeal. 
Hot inflation data last week and bets on further US Federal Reserve increases to interest rates have helped to lift the dollar in recent sessions.
The dollar index was up 0.1 per cent at 103.50 for its highest since April 2, 2025. The euro was 0.1 per cent down at $1.10093.

"With inflation still uncomfortable and scope for a hawkish 2027 surprise, EUR/USD at 1.08 looks achievable into year-end," said Benjamin Ford, researcher at macro research and strategy firm Macro Hive.
Data last week showed US consumer prices increased by more than expected in October, cementing expectations that the Fed will raise interest rates next month.
The odds of rates increasing by half a percentage point at the Fed's December meeting rose last week after inflation data appeared to clear the bar set by Fed Governor Christopher Waller for considering a quicker pace of rate hikes.
Fed funds futures are pricing an implied 93.4 per cent probability of an increase of 25 basis points at the US central bank's next two-day meeting ending on December 9, with a nearly 10 per cent likelihood of a 50-point hike, according to CME Group's FedWatch tool.
"The Fed looks set to have little inflation respite for two reasons. First, national-implied inflation, via regional surveys, points to accelerating price pressures," Macro Hive's Ford said in a note.
"Second, this is coming alongside improved profit margins: higher costs are being passed on, while there is an increasing likelihood that wages can be raised."
Investors now await remarks from Fed Chair Kevin Warsh at the Fed's Productivity and Jobs Task Force Conference in San Francisco on Monday. 
Traders will also be watching third-quarter earnings of AI industry bellwether Nvidia on Tuesday and Anthropic's market debut this week for clues on investor risk appetite.
YEN INTERVENTION RISK
The dollar slipped 0.1 per cent to 159.48 yen as markets assessed the potential impact on Bank of Japan policy from data showing Japan's economy contracted by an annualised 0.1 per cent in the July-September quarter.
The yen remains close to levels where US and Japanese authorities are believed to have intervened earlier this year.
"Unless weakness spreads into wages, services and underlying domestic demand, the BoJ is likely to look through the soft patch," said Masahiko Loo, chief fixed-income strategist at State Street Investment Management in Tokyo.
The stronger dollar weighed on the pound, sending the British currency down 0.2 per cent to $1.31895 as traders awaited British job growth and inflation data later in the week.
In cryptocurrency markets, bitcoin lost 1.4 per cent to $64,110, remaining fragile after a three-day rout that took the biggest digital asset to a four-month low over the weekend.

Source: Reuters

items.title: ＡＩが金融にもたらすリスク、バーＦＲＢ理事が多角的に指摘
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [１６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[１６日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のバー理事は１６日、人工知能（ＡＩ）が取引やサイバーセキュリティー、消費者・投資家保護にもたらし得るさまざまなリスクを指摘した。ＦＲＢが先週公表した報告書では、ＡＩが金融の安定に及ぼすリスクへの懸念が急速に高まっていることが示されており、同氏はこうした懸念をさらに掘り下げた。

１３日公表の最新の金融安定報告書に向けた調査では、回答者の約８７％がＡＩを米国の金融システムにとっての主要なリスクに挙げた。サイバー攻撃や複雑なＡＩ関連の資金調達、ＡＩ関連の利益成長鈍化が株式市場全体の下落を引き起こす可能性への懸念が示された。

バー氏は１６日、これらの懸念の一部について詳しく説明するとともに、さらに複数のリスクを挙げた。取引でＡＩモデルへの依存が高まれば、市場参加者が一斉に同じ行動を取り、市場に混乱をもたらす可能性があると指摘。自己学習するアルゴリズムが相場を操縦し、市場を不安定化させる恐れもあるとした。

また、「個人顧客の口座で操作を実行しようとする」ＡＩエージェントについて、銀行が、そのＡＩエージェントに顧客が実際に権限を与えているかどうかを確認できない可能性を挙げた。正当な権限を持つＡＩエージェントでも、個人顧客に代わって極めて高速に行動することで取り付け騒ぎを加速させ、従来の安全策では対応しきれなくなる恐れがあるとした。

ＡＩを利用するサイバー攻撃者や、制御を離れたＡＩエージェントが金融システムの脆弱性を突くサイバーリスクも指摘した。

バー氏は、ＡＩ開発企業がモデルについて「適切に制御され、数値面でも法律面でも正確で、説明可能かつ再現可能」であることを確保するのに苦慮していると述べた。

「ＡＩが消費者向け融資における偏りを強めるリスクを低減する必要がある。また、金融市場でのＡＩ利用によって生じ得るリスクにも備えなければならない。これには共謀や相場操縦、市場の大幅な変動、さらにはシステミックリスクを引き起こす取引戦略が含まれる」と語った。

イタリアのミラノでの講演に向けて用意された今回の発言は、ウォーシュＦＲＢ議長がサンフランシスコ連銀で開かれる会議で開会のあいさつを行う数時間前に公表された。同会議では、ＡＩ開発企業や企業幹部、学識者らが、ＡＩが生産性や雇用、経済全般に及ぼす影響を議論する予定だ。

バー氏は講演原稿で、金融政策や経済の見通しには言及しなかった。

イタリアのミラノでの講演に向けて用意された今回の発言は、ウォーシュＦＲＢ議長がサンフランシスコ連銀で開かれる会議で開会のあいさつを行う数時間前に公表された。同会議では、ＡＩ開発企業や企業幹部、学識者らが、ＡＩが生産性や雇用、経済全般に及ぼす影響を議論する予定だ。

バー氏は講演原稿で、金融政策や経済の見通しには言及しなかった。

Nov 16 : Federal Reserve Governor Michael Barr on Monday laid out a range of perils that AI could bring to trading, cybersecurity and consumer and investor protection, building on a central bank report issued last week that showed a surge in concern about the risks the new technology poses to financial stability.
Some 87 per cent of contacts surveyed for the Fed's latest Financial Stability Report, issued on Friday, cited AI as a salient risk to the financial system, pointing to worries about cyberattacks, complex AI-related financing, and the possibility of an AI earnings slowdown spurring broad stock market declines.
Barr on Monday expanded on some of those concerns and piled on several more: the potential that an increased reliance on AI models in trading could lead to herd-like behavior that could disrupt markets. That self-learning algorithms could manipulate and destabilize markets. That banks may be unable to confirm if an AI agent "attempting to take actions in retail customer accounts" is actually authorized by the customer to do so. That even legitimate AI agents acting at lightning speed on behalf of retail banking customers could accelerate bank runs and overwhelm traditional safeguards. 
He also pointed to cyber risks from AI-enabled cyberattackers or even rogue AI agents exploiting vulnerabilities in the financial system.

AI developers struggle with ensuring their models are "well controlled, numerically and legally precise, explainable, and replicable," he said. "We need to reduce the risk that AI reinforces biases in consumer lending. And we also need to guard against the risks that could result from the use of AI in financial markets including collusion, market manipulation, or trading strategies that result in significant market volatility or even systemic risk."
Barr's remarks, for delivery in Milan, Italy, come hours before Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh opens a conference at the San Francisco Fed where AI developers, business leaders and academics are expected to discuss the implications of the new technology for productivity, jobs and the economy more broadly.
He did not comment on the outlook for monetary policy or the economy in his prepared remarks.

items.title: Colombia inicia gira en Nueva York que busca más de US$50.000 millones en inversión
items.author: Daniel Guerrero
items.summary: Durante la semana ofrecerá un portafolio de proyectos de infraestructura, energía, minería, tecnología, agroindustria y turismo. Busca conectar iniciativas colombianas con fondos, empresas y entidades ...
items.body: Bogotá — Colombia arranca hoy en Nueva York su road show con el cual ofrecerá un portafolio de proyectos con expectativas de inversión y financiación por más de US$50.000 millones. Las oficinas del Citi y de JP Morgan en Nueva York serán el marco de la primera Milagro Week, que tendrá lugar desde hoy y hasta el 19 de noviembre. La estrategia, liderada por el vicepresidente José Manuel Restrepo, hace parte de Misión Crecer y busca presentar oportunidades de inversión ante fondos, empresas y entidades financieras internacionales. El Gobierno había anunciado inicialmente un portafolio superior a COP$75 billones, mientras que una selección de 97 proyectos que ya despertaron interés de inversionistas representa expectativas de US$41.900 millones. “Esos 97 proyectos representan expectativas de inversión o de financiación del orden de US$41.900 millones”, dijo Restrepo. El funcionario agregó que “dos de cada tres proyectos son de iniciativa privada, no van a requerir recursos del sector público para ser financiados”. Entre las iniciativas que llegarán a Nueva York está la quinta generación de la vía Villeta-Guaduas-El Korán, en Cundinamarca, con una inversión cercana a US$1.190 millones. En energía se presentarán los proyectos eólicos Aura I y Aura II, en La Guajira, que requieren más de US$1.100 millones. También aparece un proyecto de centro de datos de hiperescala en la Zona Franca de Bogotá, cuya inversión proyectada se acerca a US$9.250 millones. La agenda también contempla oportunidades en transporte, incluyendo proyectos ferroviarios y de expansión del transporte masivo. Entre ellos está la Línea 4 del Metro de Bogotá, para la cual se buscan recursos para financiar sus estudios de prefactibilidad y factibilidad. El portafolio incluye además proyectos de agroindustria, como Bioenergía de la Orinoquía, con una inversión aproximada de US$550 millones, además de iniciativas de turismo, farmacéutica, bioeconomía y tecnologías de la información. Restrepo destacó que la convocatoria reúne iniciativas de diferentes tamaños y actividades. “Tenemos además proyectos de distintas dimensiones, de distintos sectores de la economía. Hay proyectos de infraestructura, energía, agroindustria, tecnología y turismo, entre otros sectores”, afirmó. La agenda en Nueva York estará organizada alrededor de mesas sectoriales para infraestructura y transporte; energía, petróleo, gas y minería; tecnología, inteligencia artificial e infraestructura digital; y farmacéutica, agroindustria y turismo. Para el vicepresidente, el objetivo es que la presentación de los proyectos se traduzca en financiación y ejecución. “Lo que hacemos con las Milagro Week es conseguirle fuentes de financiación a unos proyectos”, señaló. El Gobierno busca así convertir el portafolio de iniciativas en nuevas inversiones para Colombia, con participación de capital privado nacional e internacional. Argentina utilizó dos ediciones de Argentina Week durante 2026 para promover oportunidades de inversión ante empresarios y fondos internacionales. La primera, en Nueva York entre el 9 y el 12 de marzo, terminó con anuncios por US$16.150 millones, según el Gobierno de Javier Milei. El encuentro reunió a más de 410 inversionistas, 210 organizaciones, 128 CEO y 11 gobernadores. Entre los principales anuncios estuvieron US$5.250 millones de First Quantum Minerals para el proyecto de cobre Taca Taca, US$4.500 millones de Pampa Energía para Vaca Muerta, US$3.400 millones de Mercado Libre para ampliar sus operaciones logísticas y US$3.000 millones de Transportadora de Gas del Sur (TGS) para industrializar líquidos de gas natural. La segunda edición, realizada en París entre el 30 de septiembre y el 2 de octubre, elevó a US$27.000 millones los anuncios de inversión reportados por el Gobierno argentino. Según el embajador en Francia, Ian Sielecki, participaron cerca de 500 CEO europeos y 13 gobernadores, en una agenda que tuvo como ejes la energía, la minería, la tecnología y el turismo. Entre los proyectos destacados figuraron US$12.400 millones de Pluspetrol para desarrollar Vaca Muerta, US$10.000 millones en proyectos de TotalEnergies, US$4.000 millones de Glencore para Agua Rica y US$1.200 millones de Pan American Energy y SNF para Cerro Dragón.

BANGKOK, Nov 16 : Thailand's central bank on Monday defended its current governing rules and warned against changes that could undermine the governor's independence, as it responded to criticism from its board chairman over the slow progress of legal reforms.
The Bank of Thailand said its 2025 review found the current Bank of Thailand Act remained appropriate and in line with international standards, with no need for changes.
• It said the BOT board had not approved any amendments to the act, though Chairman Somchai Sajjapongse later pushed for changes
• Among the issues previously raised and studied was whether the governor's performance assessment could be used when seeking grounds for dismissal

FAST

MILAN: An Italian court has placed the European unit of British bank Revolut under judicial administration after finding that convicted mobsters and money launderers had funnelled illicit cash through its accounts.
The one-year measure targets Lithuania-based Revolut Bank UAB, which operates in Italy through a local branch. In a 39-page ruling reviewed by Reuters, the court cited "serious deficiencies" in the lender's anti-money laundering controls.
The Milan court said inadequate safeguards had enabled 24 people, either under investigation or already convicted of various crimes, to conceal financial flows totalling €41.9 million (US$46.2 million) between 2021 and 2026.
During that time, rival lenders filed 265 suspicious transaction reports regarding the 24 suspects, while Revolut Bank UAB filed none, the ruling said.

Revolut is not under criminal investigation, and the oversight applies exclusively to its Italian operations, with no expected disruption to retail or commercial services.
The company was not immediately available for comment.
As in previous cases involving companies in sectors such as fashion and logistics, the judicial administration measure is preventive rather than punitive. It is designed to protect a company while restoring internal compliance and control systems aimed at forestalling future criminal conduct.
ALLEGED SHORTCOMINGS WERE NOT ISOLATED, JUDGES SAY Milan prosecutors and the court attributed what they described as negligent conduct to the bank, alleging that it had failed to implement adequate controls to avoid illicit activity.
Revolut Bank UAB, the group's licensed entity in Lithuania that operates the Italian branch, is ultimately owned by UK-based Revolut Group Holdings Ltd.
Prosecutors said the Revolut group has more than 50 million customers worldwide and over 5 million in Italy, making it the country's fifth-largest banking provider by client numbers and its top foreign bank.
The court said the alleged shortcomings in controls were not isolated incidents but were "embedded in a stable management model, repeatedly applied over time", which prevented authorities from identifying and freezing illicit funds.
GAINING AN UNFAIR ADVANTAGE In their filing, prosecutors said the bank had been used as a "financial reservoir" for serious criminals, giving it an unfair advantage over rival institutions equipped with adequate anti-money laundering systems.
The court appointed two judicial administrators tasked with broad oversight and inspection powers, which could be expanded if the bank failed to cooperate fully or if further critical issues emerged.
The measure will remain in place for one year, subject to periodic reviews of its implementation.
Under the ruling, Revolut must execute a 15-point remediation plan. It has five days to appoint an internal liaison officer and 60 days to submit an action plan addressing its compliance failures.
The administrators are required to file a preliminary report within 30 days and a comprehensive assessment of Revolut's anti-money laundering controls within 90 days.
ECONOMY MINISTRY ASSESSING POSSIBLE PENALTIES The judicial action stems from a 2024 inspection by Milan's Guardia di Finanza police into Revolut Digital Assets Europe (formerly called RT Digital Securities Cyprus), the entity that handles cryptocurrency services for European users.
In a report completed in December 2024, financial police alleged more than one million violations of customer due-diligence and data-retention rules, alongside 60 failures to flag suspicious transactions.
The report was sent to Italy's Economy Ministry, which is responsible for imposing administrative sanctions.
The ministry has not formally opened sanction proceedings because the deadline for Revolut to file objections runs until 2027, two sources with direct knowledge of the matter said.
 

Source: Reuters/ec

LONDON, Nov 16 : Britain's media regulator Ofcom announced new online child-safety rules on Monday, requiring platforms to take stronger action against child sexual abuse material and grooming ahead of a planned ban on social media access for under-16s.
Countries from Australia and Britain to France, Denmark and Turkey are moving to restrict children's access to online platforms and impose tougher obligations on technology companies over content moderation and child safety.
Ofcom's new measures in Britain would require social media platforms, file-sharing services, pornography sites and other online services to ban users who generate, upload or share child sexual abuse material.
The regulator said it would also require them to expand the use of technology to detect and remove known illegal images, and in some cases, deploy automated tools to identify previously unknown content.

The new rules are expected to take effect from early 2027, subject to parliamentary approval, Ofcome said.
Ofcom said the new measures were needed because of the scale of child sexual abuse material online, which it said had been exacerbated by advances in artificial intelligence.
"While we have seen progress from industry on tackling child sexual abuse on their platforms, we are not satisfied that enough is being done," Oliver Griffiths, director of Ofcom's Online Safety Group, said.
In a separate measure, Britain announced in June that platforms such as TikTok, Instagram, Snapchat and X would be barred from providing services to children under 16, saying the move would help "give kids their childhood back".
HASH-MATCHING REQUIREMENTS
Under the new rules, a wide range of services, including pornography sites, would have to use so-called "hash-matching" technology to identify and remove known child sexual abuse material, Ofcom said.
Hash-matching compares uploaded images and videos against databases of known illegal content, allowing platforms to identify and remove material automatically.
Britain's government said the same technology would also have to be used by relevant services to detect and remove known terrorist content.
"The online world has been left to police itself for too long and it is children and families who have paid the price," Ian Murray, the online safety minister, said in a statement.
Ofcom is also requiring platforms subject to anti-grooming duties to protect children's accounts by default and said certain platforms would have to take greater precautions before recommending content to children through their algorithms.
The measures form part of the rollout of Britain's Online Safety Act, under which Ofcom can fine companies up to 10 per cent of global revenue.
The regulator has already launched a series of investigations into platforms including Meta's Instagram services.

Source: Reuters

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [１６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[１６日 ロイター] - ヨルダン当局は１６日、国家安全保障上の懸念から、国内でメッセージングアプリ「テレグラム」を遮断すると発表した。

「既存の法律に基づき、社会の安全と国益を脅かす過激主義や急進化の拡散を図る試み」を含む脅威から社会を守ることを目的としていると説明した。

先月発生した教会襲撃では９人が死亡し、これを受けて隣国シリアへの空爆が行われ、ヨルダン当局によると過激派「イスラム国」の２０人が死亡。３人の襲撃犯は１５日に死刑判決を受けた。

ヨルダン当局は今月５日、アンマンで「テロリスト」による攻撃が発生し、治安要員１人が死亡、もう１人が負傷したと発表した。

イスラム国は長年、テレグラムを利用して声明を発表してきた。

items.summary: Bangladesh’s new eligibility status creates an important opportunity for DFC to help address the country’s substantial economic development needs by mobilising private investment, the statement said.
items.body:
Bangladesh becomes Development Finance Corporation-eligible country Bangladesh’s new eligibility status creates an important opportunity for DFC to help address the country’s substantial economic development needs by mobilising private investment, the statement said.
ANI | Updated: 16-11-2026 23:05 IST | Created: 16-11-2026 23:05 IST

Representative Image (File Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

The US International Development Finance Corporation (DFC) today announced that projects in Bangladesh are now eligible for DFC financing, the US Embassy in Dhaka said in a statement on Monday. DFC’s investments in South Asia serve as a stabilising force by supporting energy, critical infrastructure, and technology projects that strengthen our alliances and protect the region’s sovereignty, it added.
Bangladesh’s new eligibility status creates an important opportunity for DFC to help address the country’s substantial economic development needs by mobilising private investment, the statement said. Expanded access to DFC financing and risk-mitigation tools will help bridge critical investment gaps and advance projects that might otherwise face financing constraints, it said.
These investments will spur economic growth by developing critical infrastructure, creating jobs, expanding access to essential services, and strengthening local businesses, it said. DFC’s support is valuable in helping commercially viable, development-focused projects overcome financing constraints or perceived risks that would otherwise deter private investment, the US Embassy said.
“Bangladesh’s eligibility for DFC financing marks an important opportunity to deepen our economic partnership and mobilise private investment that delivers lasting growth. By supporting projects that strengthen critical infrastructure, we can unlock economic opportunity for Bangladesh while advancing U.S. strategic interests,” said Ben Black, DFC CEO. “The United States believes that promoting open economies and reciprocal trade will spur economic growth in Bangladesh, and th Agreement on Reciprocal Trade is our public commitment to supporting Bangladesh through this process. DFC financing can play an important role in making that vision a reality – spurring further prosperity in both of our countries,” said Brent T. Christensen, US Ambassador to Bangladesh.
Home to more than half the world’s population and some of its fastest-growing economies, the Indo-Pacific offers significant opportunities for strategic US investment. DFC is committed to helping American businesses expand their presence in the region, mobilizing private capital to advance economic growth rooted in free-market principles and strengthening US  economic partnerships, the statement said. The U.S. International Development Finance Corporation (DFC) is the international investment arm of the United States Government and central to US economic statecraft. DFC mobilises private capital to advance U.S. foreign policyand economic development. (ANI)

items.summary: [パリ １６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[パリ １６日 ロイター] - フランス全土で続く街頭デモや学校封鎖の際に警察隊に向けて使われたなどとして、内務省は筒型の打ち上げ花火の販売と使用を一時的に禁止した。Ｘで明らかにした。

禁止措置は２７日まで。同省は「中等学校や大学の前での封鎖やデモの際、火工品や花火の使用によって公共の秩序が著しく乱される危険を防ぐ」ことが目的だと説明した。

items.title: 原油先物が小反発、ホルムズ海峡で新たなタンカー炎上情報
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Helen Clark　Trixie Yap

[１６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Helen Clark　Trixie Yap

[１６日 ロイター] - １６日の原油先物価格は小反発。ホルムズ海峡で新たなタンカーインシデントが発生し、中東産原油の供給リスクが浮き彫りになったことを受けた。

０７５７ＧＭＴ（日本時間午後４時５７分）時点で、北海ブレント先物は０．０５ドル（０．１％）高の１バレル＝９５．８９ドル、米ＷＴＩ先物は０．０９ドル（０．１％）高の８８．６５ドルとなった。両指標ともアジア市場の序盤には下落しており、ブレントは一時１％安まで下落していた。

イランの革命防衛隊は１６日、ホルムズ海峡で２隻の石油タンカーが機雷に接触し爆発が起きたと発表。これに先立ち、１５日と１６日に同様のインシデントで６隻のタンカーが炎上していた。ロイターはこの情報を独自に確認することはできなかった。

ＢＭＩのアナリストは顧客向けリポートで、石油輸出国機構（ＯＰＥＣ）加盟国とロシアなど非加盟産油国で構成する「ＯＰＥＣプラス」からの輸出の流れの回復は依然として脆弱であり、「地域の供給は途絶の再発に対して極めて脆弱」と指摘。「そのため、米国とイランの間で合意が成立するまでは、生産と輸出に対する物理的な制約に加え、地政学的リスクプレミアムの変動が価格動向を左右し続けるだろう」と述べた。

ＫＣＭトレードのチーフアナリスト、ティム・ウォーターラー氏は、高止まりしている海運運賃も原油価格の下支え要因となっていると指摘した。

MOSCOW: Ukraine fired hundreds of drones at Russia overnight, aiming towards Moscow and hitting a symbolic bridge that links the annexed Crimean peninsula to Russia.
The strike on the bridge appeared to inflict only minor damage, though drew an angry response from Russian-installed officials.
Ukraine launched 1,336 drones in the barrage, Moscow's defence ministry said in a statement - the second-highest daily figure so far this year, according to an AFP tally of official Russian statements.
The barrage came days before a summit in Shenzhen between President Vladimir Putin, US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping. US officials say Russia's war against Ukraine is not expected to be a focus of the talks.

"The enemy has hit the Crimea bridge," Crimean's Russian-installed governor Sergey Aksyonov wrote on Telegram. "As a result, traffic will be restricted, likely until the afternoon."
He did not say whether anyone was killed or wounded in the strike. Social media channels close to the Russian army indicated no serious damage had been sustained in the attack.
The bridge has been a key target for Ukraine since Russia launched its offensive in February 2022.
It has been struck several times, including an October 2022 blast in which an explosive-packed truck was detonated on the bridge, causing months of disruption.
Around 600 of the drones were intercepted on approach to the Russian capital, Moscow Mayor Sergei Sobyanin said.
The interceptions came hours after Ukrainian forces struck a major Russian petrochemical plant, an oil refinery and a military production site.
Kyiv says its retaliatory strikes are justified retribution for Moscow's own missile and drone barrages of its cities and energy grid -- attacks that have killed hundreds of civilians and regularly knock out power and heating for millions.
"WORLD PEACE" Diplomatic efforts on ending the almost five-year war have so far gone nowhere.
After a fresh round of talks in Abu Dhabi last week, Russian President Vladimir Putin reiterated his hardline territorial demands and said any deployment of foreign troops would be seen in Moscow as a "continuation of war".
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said the United States had proposed Kyiv ceding some territory in exchange for being given NATO membership .
Moscow has repeatedly said it will not accept Ukraine being admitted to the US-led alliance.
Against that backdrop, China confirmed on Monday (Nov 16) that Xi would hold talks with Trump and Putin in Shenzhen on Nov 19 on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit.
The Kremlin and White House had previously confirmed the meeting.
Beijing said the trio would discuss "world peace".
Trump has said he intends to discuss denuclearisation and the Iran war.
He is not expected to discuss Russia's war against Ukraine in the trilateral talks, according to US officials.
Zelensky has warned that the Shenzhen meeting risks becoming a 21st-century version of the 1945 Yalta conference, where major powers could attempt to redraw spheres of influence without smaller countries at the table.

Source: Reuters/ec

items.title: ＡＩと政府債務、欧州金融安定の主要リスク＝ＥＣＢ副総裁
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [フランクフルト １６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[フランクフルト １６日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）のブイチッチ副総裁は１６日、ユーロ圏の金融安定リスクの中で、人工知能（ＡＩ）と政府債務への懸念が「極めて際立っている」と述べ、政策当局者が注意を払う必要があると指摘した。

フランクフルトでの講演で、ＡＩは以前、株価のバリュエーションの問題とみられていたが、今では債券・株式市場やサイバーセキュリティー、業務の安全性にまで影響が及ぶシステミックな懸念に変わったと述べた。

「市場で価格が修正されるリスクは和らぐどころか一段と高まっている。それに加え、外部資金の調達先が株式市場から債券市場へ広がっていることや、エクスポージャーの集中、ＡＩ導入の加速、サイバー攻撃の可能性など、さまざまな要因が金融システム全体の安定を脅かすＡＩ関連リスクを生んでいる」と分析した。

米大手テクノロジー企業は２０３０年までに５兆５０００億ドルの資金を必要としている。ブイチッチ氏は、これに伴い社債や株式の発行が増えているが、不透明な簿外の資金調達や、資金を循環させる金融取引も生まれていると指摘した。

また「ＡＩシステムの能力と自律性が高まるにつれ、サイバー攻撃は大規模化、高速化、高度化している」とし「ソーシャルエンジニアリング攻撃も効果を増している」と述べた。

金融機関が防御のためにＡＩを活用する際には、コストの増大や制約の強まりに直面する可能性があるため、こうした傾向は攻撃側に優位に働く恐れがあるとした。

政府債務を巡っては、借り入れコストの上昇に低い潜在成長率が重なれば、財政がさらに圧迫され、多額の債務を抱える国々への懸念が再燃する可能性があると述べた。「同時に、ＡＩ投資ブームに伴う巨額の資金需要により、公的部門と民間部門の借り手の間で資金の奪い合いが起きる可能性が懸念される」と続けた。

items.title: 米国と日本含む同盟国、ＡＩ技術とインフラの保護に向け協力
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
[１６日 ロイター] - 米国務省は１５日夜、米国とその同盟国９カ国が人工知能（ＡＩ）のサプライチェーン（供給網）を支える技術や重要インフラの安全確保に向けた取り組みを調整するための宣言に署名したと発表した。

署名国には米国、オーストラリア、インド、イスラエル、日本、韓国、カタール、シンガポール、アラブ首長国連邦、英国が含まれている。

• 「サンフランシスコ宣言」は、経済安全保障が国家安全保障を支えると述べ、機密性の高い技術やＡＩインフラの共同保護を呼びかけている。

items.title: アングル：尽きる「頼れる安全資産」、米国債や金の値動き不安定
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Karen Brettell

[ニューヨーク １６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Karen Brettell

[ニューヨーク １６日 ロイター] - 今月に入って株価が急落した際、投資家はここ数十年来の常とう手段である米国債や日本円への買い入れに動いた。しかし、最近の売りにより、ある深刻化する問題が浮き彫りになった。それはポートフォリオのクッションとなるはずの資産が、投資家が最も必要とする時に必ずしも機能するとは限らないということだ。

２０２５年４月、米国の関税導入への懸念から株が売られたが、米国債は例年のようなクッションの役割を果たさなかった。投資家がインフレ、財政リスク、市場の流動性逼迫を懸念したため、長期債も株式と同様に売られ、１０年物利回りは急上昇した。２月２８日に始まった米国・イスラエルとイランとの戦争も同様の動きをもたらした。インフレが加速するとの懸念から、原油価格が急騰し、債券利回りが上昇した。

金相場も同様に不安定な動きを見せている。１０月下旬には株式市場とともに下落し、テクニカルの支持線を割り込み、１年ぶりの安値を記録した。

「頼れる安全資産が尽きつつある」と、スタンダードチャータード銀行のＧ１０為替調査グローバル責任者兼北米マクロ戦略責任者であるスティーブ・エンゲランダー氏は述べた。

安全資産は、市場が下落した際に価値を維持・上昇する傾向がある。投資家は、ポートフォリオの他の部分で生じた損失を相殺するためにこれらを購入する。

ポジションはファンダメンタルズと同じくらい重要だ。エンゲランダー氏によれば、ショック発生後の最も強力な安全資産とは、単に投資家がショートポジションだったため、やむを得ず買い戻さざるを得なくなる資産である場合もあるという。

＜米国債に追加的リスク＞

米国債は依然として世界最大かつ最も流動性の高い市場であり、投資家は危機の際には長年にわたり逃避先としてきた。しかし、脅威がインフレや米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の金融引き締めである場合、債券は株式と同様に値下がりする可能性がある。

ＦＨＮファイナンシャルのマクロストラテジスト、ウィル・コンパーノール氏は、昨年の米国の関税発表を巡るボラティリティーにより、米国債の魅力が失われたかどうかを判断するのは困難だったと指摘。「米国売り」取引のうわさは、国際的な取引フローでは有意な形で現れなかったという。

一方、フランスの財政懸念に起因するボラティリティーなどの最近の事態は、米国債が「依然として安全資産としての地位を維持している」ことを示すと説明。「リスク回避ムードが高まれば、米国債は魅力的だ。しかし、インフレや地政学的リスクが生じれば、安全な資産はほとんどない」。

デューク大学フクア・スクール・オブ・ビジネスのキャンベル・ハーべイ教授（金融学）は、米国債を「世界における安全資産の指標」と表現。しかし、株式と米国債の動きはますます連動するようになっており、株式６０％、債券４０％というベンチマーク・ポートフォリオは「大きな打撃」を受けているという。

「歴史的には信頼できるものだった。しかし、分散投資によるメリットは減少している」と話す。米国の借入規模――４０兆ドルの債務、年間約２兆ドルの財政赤字、年間１兆１０００億ドルの利払い――にも言及し、米国債には今や追加的なリスクが伴うとする。

＜金の役割「大きく変化」＞

金が「安全資産」として評価されるのは、長期保有を前提としているからだ。ハーべイ教授は、金は「極めて長期、つまり数世紀というスパンでは」非常に信頼性が高いが、短期ではそうではないと述べた。

金の年率換算ボラティリティーは１５％を超えており、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００指数と同程度だ。株式との相関は３─５年の期間ではほぼゼロに近いが、これは平均値であり短期的には大きく逸脱する可能性を指摘。同氏の調査によると、インフレ率の上方サプライズは通常、市場の低迷と関連しており、そうした局面では金価格も下落する可能性がある。

スタンダードチャータードのコモディティー調査担当グローバル責任者スキ・クーパー氏は、金の役割は「大きく変化した」と指摘。投資家は、極端な状況下で活用できる高品質で流動性の高い資産として、金をますます重視している。株式市場の急落がマージンコールを引き起こした場合、特に１月まで過去最高値を更新し続けていた金については、売却の対象として真っ先に挙げられると語った。

クーパー氏は、より長期的な保有期間においては、構造的な要因が依然として存在し、その要因には、２２年以降の中央銀行による過去最高の買い入れや、世界的な債務問題、ドル離れ、通貨の価値低下への懸念が含まれる。

＜戦略の組み合わせ＞

エンゲランダー氏は、どの通貨にも弱点があると指摘する。

スイスフランは割高で、ユーロは政治的・経済的な課題に直面している。ポンドは好調だったが、労働党政権はここ数年のどの英国政府よりも左寄りの立場にあると評価。円はパフォーマンスにばらつきがあるが、市場のボラティリティーが原油価格に起因しない限り、安全資産として魅力的になり得る。日本はエネルギーを輸入に依存しているため、円は原油価格の影響を受けやすい。

ドルは他の多くの通貨よりも高い安全性と利回りを提供している。投資家は米国債に資金を投入し、「４．５％の利息を受け取り」、ボラティリティーが収まった後にどこに投資するかを決定することができる。同氏は「消去法的にはそれがおそらく安全資産の中でも最も安全な選択肢」だとした。

ハーべイ氏は、単一の資産で「あらゆる状況下で信頼できるヘッジ」となるものは存在しないと指摘。金や米国債は防御的なポートフォリオの一部で、コモディティーやその他の実物資産、インフレ連動型米国債も、アクティブ戦略と併せて役割を果たすと語る。例えば、質の高い企業をロングとし質の低い企業をショートにする「クオリティー戦略」は、大幅な下落局面でも損失を最小限に抑えられる可能性がある。「トレンドフォロー戦略」は売り局面で良好なパフォーマンスを発揮する。

これらはいずれも単独では確実に機能するものではないものの、これらを組み合わせることで、「防御型ポートフォリオが実際に機能する可能性を高めることができる」と述べた。

スイスフランは割高で、ユーロは政治的・経済的な課題に直面している。ポンドは好調だったが、労働党政権はここ数年のどの英国政府よりも左寄りの立場にあると評価。円はパフォーマンスにばらつきがあるが、市場のボラティリティーが原油価格に起因しない限り、安全資産として魅力的になり得る。日本はエネルギーを輸入に依存しているため、円は原油価格の影響を受けやすい。

ドルは他の多くの通貨よりも高い安全性と利回りを提供している。投資家は米国債に資金を投入し、「４．５％の利息を受け取り」、ボラティリティーが収まった後にどこに投資するかを決定することができる。同氏は「消去法的にはそれがおそらく安全資産の中でも最も安全な選択肢」だとした。

ハーべイ氏は、単一の資産で「あらゆる状況下で信頼できるヘッジ」となるものは存在しないと指摘。金や米国債は防御的なポートフォリオの一部で、コモディティーやその他の実物資産、インフレ連動型米国債も、アクティブ戦略と併せて役割を果たすと語る。例えば、質の高い企業をロングとし質の低い企業をショートにする「クオリティー戦略」は、大幅な下落局面でも損失を最小限に抑えられる可能性がある。「トレンドフォロー戦略」は売り局面で良好なパフォーマンスを発揮する。

これらはいずれも単独では確実に機能するものではないものの、これらを組み合わせることで、「防御型ポートフォリオが実際に機能する可能性を高めることができる」と述べた。

items.title: 中国・香港株式市場・大引け＝中国株16カ月ぶりの安値付近、ＡＩハードウエアに売り　ハンセン指数は上昇
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [上海 １６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[上海 １６日 ロイター] - 中国株式市場は下落して終了。ＡＩ（人工知能）相場の上昇持続性に対する懸念がセンチメントを冷やし、ハードウエア株が下落した。国内経済の弱さを示す新たな兆候も相まって、２０２５年７月以来の安値付近で推移した。

ＣＳＩ３００指数と上海総合指数はいずれも０．９％安で取引を終えた。香港のハンセン指数は０．５％高となった。

中国のＡＩハードウエア関連株の下落は、アジアの同業他社に追随する形となった。

５Ｇ通信指数は７．５％急落し、１年ぶりの安値を記録。上海証券取引所の新興ハイテク企業向け株式市場「科創板」の科創板５０指数は５．２％下落した。

ViaBTCのチーフアナリスト、ジェフ・コー氏は、エヌビディアを巡る騒動が中国の半導体メーカーにとって分水嶺となる可能性があると指摘。「もし米国がこの騒動を受けて輸出規制を強化すれば、中国国内のＡＩチップやコンピューティングインフラへの投資が加速する可能性がある」と述べた。

半面、ＣＳＩ３００金融指数は１．５％上昇し、生活必需品株指数は１．２％上昇した。
